nusmp.skill.grimoire_crystal.description: Grimoire magic: Crystal Magic. The mage grows and shapes crystal out of the grimoire: bolts, shard volleys and prism beams of refracted light, cages and domes of faceted glass, and a scope that shows every foe for miles. Its pages strike and splinter, blind and pin, dash through light, harden your body into crystal and raise fields of thrusting gems, with a Grand Prism Cannon as the signature and a daily Crystal Resonance that mends friends and shakes foes apart. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_crystal.description: The grimoire of Crystal Magic: twelve pages of faceted crystal. Starters fire a piercing crystal bolt that marks its target and a fan of slowing shards; mid pages cast a blinding Prism Beam that refracts into nearby foes, Shatter Burst, a pinning Crystal Cage, a Prism Step dash, the Crystal Scope that reveals every enemy within 48 blocks, and Crystal Armor; the zone pages raise a Crystal Garden and a projectile-reflecting Prism Dome; the signature is the Grand Prism Cannon; the daily Crystal Resonance heals allies and shakes foes. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_strike: A single faceted spear of crystal is flung from the open grimoire and does not stop for the first thing it meets. It flies 22 blocks at speed 1.6, pierces every enemy on its line for 8 damage scaled by Existence Points, and leaves each of them Glowing for 5 seconds so the other pages can find them.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_curse.description: Grimoire magic: Curse Magic. Stacking Hex Marks that make foes take more damage, poison and wasting over time, spiritual damage and a shrunken life pool, drained magicules, a cursed formation zone, and a curse that spreads when a marked foe dies. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_curse.description: Curse Magic lays lasting wrongs on a body instead of only wounding it. Its core is the Hex Mark: up to five stack on a victim for 20 seconds, and each one makes them take 6% more damage (3% for bosses). A marked foe that dies with two or more marks passes the curse on, with one mark fewer, to up to six others within 6 blocks. Around that core the pages run from poison badgers and a bronze lizard, through ash that drains magicules, a tether that siphons a cursed foe, a ward that curses whoever strikes it and a cursed dash, to a poison cloud zone, the Ultra Giant Bull, and the daily Curse Epidemic. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_curse.curse_strike: The plainest curse: a bolt of ill will thrown straight and fast. It pierces everything in a line for 8 damage (scaled by your EP) and leaves no mark of its own.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_curse_warding.descr: Grimoire magic: Curse-Warding Magic. Cleanse curses and debuffs, move them onto enemies, reflect them with the Mirror Ward, bind a foe with Unbound Slave, hold the ground with Ward Circle and Decaying World, and detonate a target with Exploding Life. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_curse_warding.descripti: Curse-Warding Magic is the craft of handling curses: lifting them, moving them, turning them back, and laying them on others. Its pale violet runes cleanse you and your allies, hand your debuffs to an enemy, reflect curses and blows back at whoever sent them, bind a foe to your will, and raise sanctuaries and fields that unmake enemy spells. Its great spells are Decaying World and Exploding Life, and the Undying Curse keeps you alive through one killing blow. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.curse_ward: A bolt of pale-violet warding runes, thrown straight and fast. It pierces a line of enemies and deals 8 damage to each, scaled by your EP.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_demon_beast.descrip: Grimoire magic: Demon Beast Magic, chimera and hydra beasts that claw, bite, roar and regrow. Its twelve pages cover claws and quills, a roaring cone, a fang lunge, terror, a horned charge, a hunting ground, a beast mantle and hide, the three-headed hydra and the daily regrowth. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_demon_beast.description: The grimoire of Demon Beast Magic, a sinister beast magic that calls the claws, fangs and voices of chimeras and hydras out of the underworld. Twelve pages: claw, quill and spirit-beast strikes; Chimera's Roar, a fang lunge, a terror howl and a horned rush; a hunting ground that rakes everything inside it; a mantle and a hide for yourself; Hydra's Many Heads; and the daily Hydra's Regrowth. Its hits make foes bleed, poison them, shred their defence and drive them mad with fear. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.demon_beast_: A spirit beast of the underworld lunges out of the grimoire in the shape of a black-violet bolt. Deals 8 damage (scaled by EP) to everything in its path, up to about 22 blocks.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_demon_fire.descript: Grimoire magic: Demon Fire Magic, a sinister black fire that burns through fire resistance, barriers and shadows alike. Its twelve pages hurl flame bullets and exploding bolts, raise pillars and a twister of black flame, turn your body to fire, and end in a rain of falling pillars. Everything it touches keeps burning with the demon burn, and a burning foe can be detonated. Hold your grimoire to cast. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_demon_fire.description: The grimoire of Demon Fire Magic: a black fire that hits as pure magic, so fire resistance and fire immunity do nothing against it. Its pages burn souls, detonate burning foes, raise pillars and twisters, wrap the caster in flame and bring down a rain of black pillars; every hit leaves the demon burn, a pulsing burn that refreshes while the fire spreads. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.demon_fire_st: The first spark of the abyss, a lance of black flame that does not stop for the first thing it meets. Pierces everything on its path for 8 damage (scaled by your existence points) with the strike's own speed and range.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_demon_ice.descripti: Grimoire magic: Demon Ice Magic, a sinister ice that slows, freezes and shatters. Its twelve pages cover ice bolts, shard volleys, a piercing lance, a frostbite cone, a soul-freezing bind, Shatter, a wall, a slide, an ice body, a blizzard zone, Absolute Zero and the daily Eternal Winter. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_demon_ice.description: The grimoire of Demon Ice Magic, a sinister frost that freezes anything, even shadows and light. Twelve pages: starter bolts, shards and a piercing lance; a frostbite wave, a soul-freezing bind, Shatter, a glacier wall, a glacier slide and Frost Body; the Blizzard zone; Absolute Zero; and the daily Eternal Winter. Every page slows and freezes what it touches, and Shatter breaks fully frozen foes for heavy damage. The heavy pages also hurt the spirit and break barriers. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_stri: A bolt of black frost leaves the grimoire and runs through everything in its path. Deals 8 damage (scaled by EP) to each foe it pierces, slows them (Slowness II, 3 s) and adds about 1.5 s of freezing.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_demon_light.descrip: Demon Light Magic is a sinister form of light: black beams with a magenta bloom, faster and denser than ordinary Light Magic and cruel to anything from the underworld. It blinds, strikes the spirit, cuts through barriers and sets undead and demons ablaze; its pages range from thrown shards and a whip of light to a prison, a veil, an eclipse zone, the Light Shaft of Divine Punishment and a once-a-day Dawn. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_demon_light.description: The grimoire of Demon Light Magic: black light that blinds foes, burns undead and demons, hurts the spirit and ignores barriers, and that mends allies in its dawn. Its twelve pages run from the Light Sword of Judgment and the Bright Judgment Whip to the Eclipse Domain and the Light Shaft of Divine Punishment. Damage, radius and healing grow with your existence points. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.demon_light_: The first light a Demon Light mage learns: a black needle thrown straight ahead. It flies 22 blocks and pierces everything in its path for 8 damage, scaled by existence points.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_demon_water.descrip: Demon Water Magic is a sinister form of water: ink-black tides lit with teal-green light that drown, crush and push, and also wash wounds closed. Its pages are a tidal push and a dark wave for starters, a drowning grasp, a healing mist, a serpent dash and a ward of the deep, the Abyssal Whirlpool as a zone, the Hydra of Darkneros as its signature, and Tide Rebirth once in a long while. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_demon_water.description: The grimoire of Demon Water Magic: corrupted water that drowns, slows and crushes foes and heals friends. Its eleven pages range from the Tidal Push to the Hydra of Darkneros, whose spiked serpents hunt down enemies, and Tide Rebirth, which cleanses and mends. Damage, radius and healing grow with your existence points, and some pages strike the spirit directly. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.demon_water_: The first tide a Demon Water mage learns: a dark wave thrown ahead like a spear. It flies 22 blocks and pierces everything in its path for 8 damage, scaled by existence points.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_eye.description: Grimoire magic: Eye Magic. The mage casts enchantments through their eyes: a gaze that strikes, marks, blinds and weakens, eyes that hunt on their own, a ward that turns shots back on the shooter, a step to wherever the mage can see, and the Union Magic Reflect Iris that paralyses everyone who looks into its mirrors. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_eye.description: The grimoire of Eye Magic: twelve pages of sight turned into a weapon. Starters strike with a look; mid pages send homing eyes, mark a target so it takes more from you and your allies, blind a crowd, curse with the Evil Eye, sharpen your own sight, ward off projectiles and step to where you look; the zone page opens a Field of Eyes, the signature is Reflect Iris, and the daily is the All-Seeing Eye that shows everything nearby through walls. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_eye.eye_strike: A bolt of focused sight leaves the eye and runs straight through whatever stands in its way. It flies 22 blocks at speed 1.6 and pierces every enemy on its line for 8 damage, scaled by Existence Points.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_eyeball.description: Grimoire magic: Eyeball Magic. The mage manifests fleshy, veined eyes that float, turn and watch on their own and share what they see. The pages shoot eye bolts that slow, send hunting eyes, snipe moving targets, turn a gaze into stone, scan for magicules, swap places, share sight with allies, shoot down incoming spells, jam the magic of everyone the eyes can see, and open the Evil Eye of Catoblepas over a whole battlefield. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_eyeball.description: The grimoire of Eyeball Magic: twelve pages of eyes that are free of the face. Starters fire an eye bolt and a sniper shot that reads movement; mid pages send hunting eyes, petrify with a gaze, scan magicules through walls, swap places with a foe, share sight with allies, circle you as guardians and leave scouting eyes behind; the zone page is a Jamming Gaze Field that silences everyone the eyes can see (break line of sight to escape), the signature is Catoblepas's Evil Eye, and the daily is a Swarm of Eyes. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.eyeball_strike: An eye tears loose from the air and flies at the enemy, trailing red veins. It flies 22 blocks, pierces every foe on its line for 8 damage scaled by Existence Points, and slows each one (Slowness I) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_food.description: Grimoire magic: Food Magic. Giant cutlery strikes, pies and rotten dishes that slow and sicken foes, banquets that heal and feed allies, and a wolf that eats spells and turns them into your magicules. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_food.description: Food Magic turns the table into a battlefield. The mage conjures giant cutlery that skewers and carves, throws pies and spoiled dishes that slow, sicken and starve enemies, and sets feasts that heal, feed and refill the magicules of allies. Its pages run from fork and knife strikes and a starving rush, through meals and a stomach that eats incoming projectiles, to the banquet table, the wolf of Glutton's Banquet that devours enemy spells, and the once-a-day Midnight Feast. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_food.food_strike: The first morsel served from the grimoire, hurled before the guests can sit down. Fires a piercing bolt of food (8 damage, scaled by your EP) that passes through every enemy in its path.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_fungus.description: Grimoire magic: Fungus Magic. Grow and command fungi: spore clouds that poison, weaken and feed on the magicules of everything inside, mycelium roots that hold enemies slow, and giant mushrooms that crush. Twelve pages from the Spore Strike up to Towering Mr. Mushroom and the daily Mycelium Bloom. Hold your grimoire to cast. Four-leaf and five-leaf grimoires hold the strongest pages.
nusmp.skill.book_fungus.description: The grimoire of Fungus Magic: dense spore clouds that poison and weaken and siphon magicules from anything inside, mycelium roots that slow, and heavy and towering mushrooms that pin and crush. Its pages cover spore bolts, roots, a heavy pinning mushroom, a sprint, a scouting whisper, spore armor, a mushroom wall, healing mycelium, a big cloud, the Towering Mr. Mushroom and a daily fungal forest. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.fungus_strike: A single spore pod thrown hard enough to burst on skin. A piercing bolt that deals 8 damage to everything it passes through, scaled by your EP.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_gel.description: Grimoire magic: Gel Magic. Sticky gel that slows and holds enemies, bouncy pads, an absorbing shield, gel that cleanses poison, and the Sticky Salamander that hunts and carries. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_gel.description: Gel Magic lets the mage call up and shape a thick, translucent gel. The gel clings and slows whatever it touches, holds enemies in place, bounces allies into the air, soaks up blows, and neutralises poison. The pages run from sticky bolts and a bursting blast, through a bouncy pad, a smothering hold and an absorbing shield, to zones of mire and the two gel salamanders. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_strike: A fist of gel thrown fast enough to pierce a line of enemies. Fires a piercing gel bolt (8 damage, scaled by your EP) that bursts on impact and leaves every target hit with Slowness II for 2 seconds.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_glass.description: Grimoire magic: Glass Magic. Razor shards that leave stacking bleed, a glass blade, panes that reveal and reflect, a Shatter that pops every cut, a flower of glass spikes and a castle of glass. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_glass.description: Glass Magic lets the mage shape sharp, translucent glass out of mana. Every shard cuts: a glass hit leaves a stacking bleed (up to 8 cuts on one target, each cut bleeding extra damage every second and leaking magicules), and four cuts make the wound leave the target fragile. The pages run from shard volleys and a piercing lance, through a glass blade, a step through the panes, Verre Detection that reveals everything nearby, a reflective prism barrier and a Shatter that pops every cut at once, to the zones of Shard Rain and Verre Fleur, the glass castle Le Chateau de Verre and the Crystal Carapace. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_glass.glass_strike: A single shard of glass thrown straight and hard. Fires a piercing glass bolt (8 damage, scaled by your EP) that cuts through every enemy on its line.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_ice_wedge.descripti: Grimoire magic: Ice Wedge Magic, ice driven in as wedges that slow, pin and split. Its twelve pages cover wedge bolts, a fan of wedges, a hammered strike that bleeds magicules, a pinning wedge that bursts, a frost-branded weapon, a wedge aegis, a V-shaped wall, a step behind the foe, a field of rising wedges, the giant World End Martyr and the daily World End Church. Everything it touches is slowed and frozen. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_ice_wedge.description: The grimoire of Ice Wedge Magic: twelve pages of wedge-shaped ice that slows, freezes and pins. Starters throw single wedges, a volley, and a driver that hammers one foe; mid pages fan wedges out in a cone, pin a foe and split the wedge open, brand your weapon with frost, ring you with a wedge aegis, raise a V-shaped wall and step you behind a foe; the zone page makes wedges thrust from the ground; the signature calls World End Martyr, a giant of sharp ice that looses freezing beams; and the daily page raises World End Church, a cold that falls to absolute zero. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.ice_wedge_stri: Wedge Strike - a single wedge of ice is flung from the grimoire and runs through every foe in its path, cold as a blade left in snow. Deals 8 damage (scaled by EP) to each foe it pierces, slows them (Slowness II, 3 s) and adds about 1 s of freezing.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_iron.description: Grimoire magic: Iron Magic. The mage forges iron out of mana: bullets of iron casing, falling blades, shackles, walls, and the great bell of the Immovable Guardian Deity. Its pages hurl explosive iron bullets, spray shrapnel, rain swords down on an area, shackle a foe, charge through enemies with an iron shoulder, harden your fists, raise a wall and a guardian bell, rust the ground under a whole crowd, and call the Iron God of War, with a daily Colossus Anvil that crushes the aimed spot. Iron hits are heavy: foes are slowed and weighed down rather than burned or frozen. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_iron.description: The grimoire of Iron Magic: twelve pages of forged iron. Starters fire iron, an exploding Iron Bullet and a cone of shrapnel; mid pages rain swords, shackle a target, charge, harden your fists, raise an iron wall and the Immovable Guardian Deity; the zone page rusts the ground; the signature is the Iron God of War; the daily drops a Colossus Anvil. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_strike: A spike of iron is forged in the air and thrown. It flies 14 blocks at speed 1.6 and pierces every enemy on its line for 8 damage, scaled by Existence Points.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_key.description: Grimoire magic: Key Magic. A mage of keys and gates: lock a foe's magic or body, unlock your allies, cross short distances through doors and loose stolen spells from the doors of a magical space. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_key.description: Key Magic makes and wields keys: golden keys that lock and unlock anything, and doors that open anywhere. Its pages throw and rain keys, lock a mage's magic and steal a share of it, seal a body away behind a keyhole, step you through a door, close a whole room around your foes, summon key weapons, and at the end open Janus Abigail's magical space or Doom's Gate. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_key.key_strike: The first key a mage learns to draw is no more than a spike of gold with a bow for a handle. It flies straight, pierces what it meets and rings off the walls. A golden key bolt flies 22 blocks, hits everything on its path for 8 damage (scales with your EP) and bursts where it ends.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_legion.description: Grimoire magic: Legion Magic. Chess-piece soldiers that march, guard, grip and strike, a banner and a barricade, Blink Castling to swap places with a soldier, the Gehenna Game board and the giant End Empress. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_legion.description: Legion Magic raises faceless soldiers shaped like chess pieces, armour that floats and obeys until its magic runs out. The pages send pawns marching in a line, muster a guard around the mage, send a knight crashing into one enemy, have soldiers seize a foe, raise a banner, pile rooks into a barricade, and let the mage swap places with any soldier. Higher pages open a circular chessboard, set a legion orbiting the mage, and merge every soldier into one giant. Pick a page, then cast it for its effect; soldiers you raise stay for a while and are what Blink Castling and End Empress draw on. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_legion.legion_strike: A single soldier's lance, thrown from the grimoire. It flies in a line, pierces everything in its path and deals 8 damage (scaled by your EP), leaving each target in Slowness for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.hex_shards: Hex Shards - three small hexagons peel off the barrier and curve after the nearest foes like swallows. Each shard deals 4.5 base damage, shoves the target slightly and weakens it for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_step: Barrier Step - the barrier is laid flat under your feet and you slide along it in one motion. You move up to 8 blocks forward, hit everything on the way for 4 base damage and slow it for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.voodoo_regalia: Voodoo Regalia - the barrier is shaped into a sword, an axe, an arrow and a trident and fired in a fan. The sword cuts and bleeds 4% of the target's magicules (6 damage, pierces), the axe breaks the guard (9 damage, fragility and weakness for 4 seconds), the arrow is fast (5 damage, pierces) and the trident hits the marked target and heaves it into the air (7 damage). The remaining barrier stays in your hand for 7 seconds and adds 3 damage to every melee hit.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_cannon: Barrier Cannon - plates of barrier align into a cannon barrel and loose a beam. It reaches about 26 blocks, deals 14 base damage to everything in a 1-block-wide line, knocks foes back and jams their magic for 4 seconds (1 second on bosses), and shatters hostile barriers and spell constructs within 3.5 blocks of where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.hexagon_wall: Hexagon Wall - cell by cell, a pane wall unfolds before you. It is 7 blocks wide and 4 high, made of translucent glass cells that block movement and sight lines for 12 seconds and then fade away.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.deflecting_pane: Deflecting Pane - a shell of barrier rings you for 8 seconds, radius 4.5 blocks. Every hostile arrow, bolt and thrown spell that touches it is turned around and sent back as yours, enemy spell bolts are dissolved, and you take 20% less damage meanwhile.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_armour: Barrier Armour - barrier material wraps your body like a bandage over every wound. You heal 6 health, put out flames and are cleansed of poison, and gain Resistance II and Absorption II for 20 seconds. Allied players within 6 blocks get a thinner coat of Absorption for 15 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.spatial_lock: Spatial Lock - the barrier is tuned against spatial and ultimate magic. Every foe within 7 blocks takes 3 base damage, has its magic jammed for 8 seconds, is anchored by Slowness III for 5 seconds and has its ultimate skills thrown onto cooldown for 8 seconds. Bosses are held for only 2 seconds and jammed for 2.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.voodoo_shangrila: Voodoo Shangrila - countless hexagons knit into a dome of 7 blocks radius around where you stand, lasting 12 seconds. Foes inside cannot leave, foes outside cannot enter, hostile projectiles break on the shell, and the trapped are magic-jammed. Allies pass freely and receive Resistance and Regeneration while they stay inside. Bosses are pushed back more weakly.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.voodoo_kingdom: Voodoo Kingdom - the Shangrila grown into a realm: an 11-block-radius dome that lasts 15 seconds. Foes are locked in, jammed and weakened, and every second barrier weapons fall on up to three of them for 6 base damage each. Allies inside gain Resistance II, Strength and Regeneration.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_reclaim: Barrier Reclaim - the barrier you have raised all day is drawn back into your body. Every harmful status effect is cleansed, you heal a quarter of your maximum health, and you gain Strength II, Speed II and Resistance for 30 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_barrage: A burst of small bubbles blown in a fan. Five bubbles fly out, each dealing 3 damage, lifting its target a little and leaving it in Slowness for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.foam_blind: A wave of thick soap suds sprayed in front of the mage. Enemies in a 7 block cone take 4 damage and are left with Blindness for 4 seconds, Slowness II for 3 seconds and Weakness for 5 seconds; bosses suffer only a third of the time.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_trap: A bubble closes around one enemy and lifts it off the ground. A hard control (shares the control cooldown): the target floats helpless for up to 4 seconds (Levitation, Slowness IV, held in place), then the bubble pops for 7 damage and it falls. Bosses are only slowed.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_burst: Bubbles swell under the enemies' feet and pop. Everything within 4 blocks of the aim point takes 9 damage and is thrown up; a moment later the bubbles in the air pop again for 6 more damage and Slowness II for 2 seconds. Bosses only hop.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_ride: A bubble takes the mage up and forward. You are launched up and ahead, float down under Slow Falling for 6 seconds and take no fall damage for 7 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_barrier: A shimmering bubble wraps the mage. For 10 seconds the barrier absorbs 4 blows: melee damage is halved and the attacker is thrown up, projectiles are swallowed whole, and you gain Absorption.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_skin: Your body turns light as a bubble. For 30 seconds you have Slow Falling, Water Breathing, Jump Boost II and no fall damage, and every melee hit pops a bubble that throws the target up and floats it for 1 second.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_refresher: A great seashell opens under the target and fills with countless soothing bubbles; one shell shelters many at once. Aim at an ally (or cast it on yourself): everyone friendly within 4 blocks is healed for 8 percent of their maximum health, then for 8 seconds is cleansed of poison, nausea and blindness and given Regeneration II.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_mines: Bubbles scattered where you aim, waiting for a touch. Five bubbles lie still in a 4.5 block area for 10 seconds; the first enemy to come near one sets it off for 8 damage to everything within 2.4 blocks, a big knock up and Levitation for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.great_bubble: A giant bubble swallows a whole crowd. A hard control (shares the control cooldown): up to ten enemies within 6 blocks of the aim point float helpless for up to 3.5 seconds, taking 2.5 damage every half second, then the great bubble bursts for 18 damage and throws them outward and up. Bosses are only slowed.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.rainbow_cocoon: Once a day, the mage and allies are sealed in a rainbow bubble of clean water. Everyone friendly within 6 blocks is cleansed of poison, healed for 35 percent of their maximum health and given strong Absorption and Regeneration II, and a barrier that absorbs 8 blows for 8 seconds; enemies within 4.5 blocks are thrown up and floated for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_flowing_blad: The dancer turns, and the water turns with them: two arcs follow one another like a single slow breath. The first sweep hits everything in a 5.5 block cone in front of you for 7 water damage, the second, 7 ticks later along your new facing, for 5. Each hit slows the target (Slowness II, 2.5 s) and pushes it back.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_rhythm_wave: Heel on the ground, three beats, and the air carries them outwards. Three shockwaves leave you 8 ticks apart, each hitting everything within 6 blocks for 3.5 water damage and shoving it back. The third beat also jams enemy casting (Magic Jamming, 4 s, 1 s on bosses) and slows them. Allies in range gain Speed I with every beat.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_sea_god_slas: Union Magic of the Seabed Temple: the swords carry a great aura, and every swing throws a shockwave and flying slashes in worship of the Sea God. A shockwave 2 blocks ahead hits for 5 and shoves hard, then three piercing water slashes fly out in a fan, 26 blocks, 10 damage to each enemy (each enemy is hit once per cast), slowing and pushing them.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_ebb_step: As the tide goes out, so does the dancer. You slip up to 7 blocks backwards, away from your facing, and leave a wet afterimage: mobs hunting you lose your trail, and everything within 2.8 blocks of where you stood is slowed (Slowness II, 2 s) and pushed. You gain Resistance III for 1.5 s and Speed II for 3 s.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_trance_dance: The longer the dancer dances, the less they are there. For 30 s you move with Speed II, your melee hits deal +3 damage, and about one blow in five finds nobody where it lands (it deals no damage). Allies within 10 blocks catch the rhythm: Speed I and Strength I for 20 s.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_tidal_veil: A curtain of water follows every motion of the sleeves. For 8 s you take less damage (Resistance II) and gain Absorption II, anything that strikes you is splashed for 2 damage in return, and arrows and spells that come within 3.5 blocks are washed away. Casting it shoves nearby enemies back 3.5 blocks and slows them.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_undertow: The dancer draws a slow circle on the floor, and the sea answers. A whirlpool 5 blocks wide forms at the spot you look at and lasts 6 s: every half second it deals 2.5 water damage, slows (Slowness III) and drags enemies toward the centre (bosses are not dragged). At the end it surges for 9 damage and throws them up.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_metronome_fi: A stage with a heartbeat. For 10 s a field 7 blocks wide stays where you cast it. Every second, allies in it gain Speed I and Strength I; enemies take 2 water damage, lose their casting rhythm (Magic Jamming, 2 s, 1 s on bosses), are slowed and weakened, and lose 1% of their magicules.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_sea_god_desc: The Sea God of the Seabed Temple is called down by a dance too slow to interrupt. The spot you look at (28 blocks) is marked by a 7 block ring; 1.2 s later the sea crashes down there for 22 water damage, throws enemies up, shoves them and slows them (Slowness IV, 4 s). 8 ticks after, an echo sweeps a wider 9.8 block ring for 8 damage.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_seabed_hymn: The worship dance performed at the bottom of the sea, once a day. It washes over 10 blocks: allies are healed for 35% of their maximum health, cleansed of harmful effects, and gain Regeneration II and Resistance I for 10 s. Enemies in range take 10 water damage, are swept back, slowed and have their casting jammed for 5 s (1 s on bosses). Cooldown 10 minutes.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_whip: The chain cracks like a whip, and what it catches does not get away. Sweeps a wide arc up to 6.5 blocks ahead for 7 damage, drags every hit enemy toward you and slows it (Slowness II) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_chain.scorpio_chain: A barbed chain curls like a scorpion tail before it stabs. Hooks the target within 18 blocks, reels it toward you (bosses barely move) and stings for 9 damage, Poison II for 4 seconds and Slowness II for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_chain.pitless_viper: Chains rise from every side, each ending in a hissing serpent head, and they strike one after another. Five strikes from five directions on one target within 20 blocks, 5 damage each with a little magicule bleed; the last bite adds Poison II for 5 seconds and Slowness III for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_chain.kunai_chains: Five kunai fly on five chains, each seeking its own prey. Fires a homing volley of five chains for 5 damage each; every hit bleeds 2 percent of the target's magicules and slows it (Slowness II) for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_chain.heavy_chain: A chain with an iron weight at its end is swung overhead and let go. It lands at the aimed point (up to 20 blocks) after 8 ticks and crushes everything within 3.5 blocks for 13 damage, slams them to the ground, and weighs them down with Slowness IV and Burden for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_chain.grapple_chain: A hooked chain bites into stone or flesh and reels the mage after it. Anchors on the block or enemy you aim at (3 to 28 blocks) and pulls you across at up to 2.6 blocks per tick, with Slow Falling for 2.5 seconds; if it hooked an enemy it also hits it for 5 damage and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_aegis: Chains circle the mage like a living ring of iron, lashing out at anything that gets close. For 8 seconds you gain Resistance II, enemies within 3.5 blocks take 3 damage every half second and are slowed (Slowness III), and enemy projectiles in the ring are torn from the air.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_armament: Chains wind round both arms down to the knuckles and the fists hit like wrecking weights. For 20 seconds your melee hits deal 3.5 extra damage, attackers take thorns damage, and you gain Resistance I.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_cage: The ground splits and a ring of chains rises, closing over the area like the bars of a cage. For 5 seconds (players 3 s, bosses 1 s) anything inside a 4.5 block radius that tries to leave is dragged back, is slowed (Slowness III) and takes 3 damage every second. Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_chain.iron_chain_formati: Chains spiral round the target's torso and the arrow-tipped ends drive into the ground around it. The target within 18 blocks is rooted (Slowness X) for up to 7 seconds, Weakened, silenced and its skills are jammed (players cannot cast grimoire spells), takes 10 damage, and every second loses some magicules (to you) and aura. Bosses are held for 1 second. Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_reckoning: Every chain the mage has ever made answers at once. Chains run through up to six enemies within 12 blocks for 8 damage each, slow them (Slowness IV) for 5 seconds, take 8 percent of their magicules and burn 10 percent of their aura, and mend you for each one. Once per 5 minutes.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.razor_pet: Six streams of petals leave the page in a fan, and they remember where the enemy stands. Six homing petals fly at 3.2 blocks per tick, each doing 3.2 damage, blinding for 2.5 seconds and cutting 1 percent of the target's magicules.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.petal_fan: The mage opens the grimoire like a fan and sweeps it once across the field. Everything within 9 blocks in front of you takes 8 damage, is blinded for 2.5 seconds, loses 1 percent of its magicules and is pushed back; up to 20 targets are hit.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.blossom_s: Petals wind around a foe until it can neither see nor move. One target within 18 blocks is blinded and rooted for up to 4 seconds (shortened by the shared control lock, bosses 1 second), takes 4 damage and is cut for 1.8 damage and a half percent of its magicules every half second.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.petal_vei: A swarm so dense that the eye loses the mage in it. For 10 seconds you are invisible with Resistance I, hunters within 16 blocks lose you as their target, every projectile entering 4.5 blocks is shredded and enemies inside the veil are blinded.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.petal_ste: The mage rides a gust of petals and the world slides past. Dash up to 9 blocks forward cutting everything on the line for 6 damage with blindness and a magicule bleed, then keep Speed II for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.beautifyi: Petals fall like a blessing, and what they touch is made whole and fair again. You and allied players within 8 blocks are healed for 22 percent of their maximum health (healing decay applies), gain Regeneration II for 8 seconds and 2 absorption hearts for 10 seconds, and lose one harmful effect.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.blossom_b: The petals gather on the fists and in the stride. For 20 seconds your melee blows deal 4 extra damage (scaled by Existence Points and mastery), and you gain Speed I and Regeneration I.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.clones_of: Clones of petals in the mage's likeness, so lifelike that even a Magic Knight is fooled. For 12 seconds three clones circle you, fly unaided, make hunters within 16 blocks lose you, and every half second each throws petals at the nearest enemy within 12 blocks for 2.5 damage with blindness and a magicule bleed.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.magic_che: A storm of petals rises at the point you aim at, so thick the sky turns pink. For 8 seconds everything within 7 blocks of the eye takes 2.5 damage every half second, is blinded, slowed, bled of a half percent of its magicules and swept toward the centre; up to 24 targets are hit.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.dance_of_: The mage opens a great fan of cherry blossoms and swings it, and a hundred million petals pour through every gap in the enemy's guard. For 4 seconds, five piercing streams leave you every fifth of a second along the way you face, swinging left and right; each petal deals 3.5 damage through invulnerability frames, blinds and bleeds magicules.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.everlasti: A grove blooms around the target point and the petals never stop falling. For 15 seconds, within 10 blocks, enemies take 3 damage, blindness, Weakness and a magicule bleed every second, while you and your allies are mended for 4 percent of maximum health and regenerate. Four temporary cherry trees stand at its edge. Once a day.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.ruby_shards: Three red shards spin out of the grimoire in a fan, each glowing like a coal. Every shard that connects deals 4 damage and sets the target on fire for 3 seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.sapphire_lance: A single blue lance of sapphire, long and cold in the hand. It strikes an 18-block line in front of you for 7 damage and leaves each target dragged down by Slowness III for 4 seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.corundum_fractu: A dense shard that does not wound the flesh so much as the armour around it. It flies 1.8 blocks per tick for 14 ticks and deals 9 damage to the first target, then cracks its defence with Weakness II and Fragility for 8 seconds (3 seconds on bosses) and bleeds 3 percent of its magicules.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.hard_blast: The ground under your aim erupts in gemstone and a hard blast rolls outward. Everything within 5 blocks of the aim point takes 10 damage, is shoved back and thrown into the air. Damage and radius scale with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.corundum_rush: You wrap your legs in gem and charge, a red streak that does not stop for anything in the way. You dash up to 9 blocks forward, dealing 6 damage and knockback to everything you pass through. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.gem_wall: A wall of red corundum thrusts up out of the earth, hard enough to stop a charge. It raises a block wall 4 wide and 3 high two and a half blocks in front of you; it holds for 8 seconds and then crumbles back to what it was.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.gem_armour: You harden your skin until it rings like a struck jewel, and anything that bites it hurts itself. For 20 seconds you gain Resistance II and Absorption II, your melee hits deal 3 extra damage, and attackers take 2 damage back.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.corundum_bastio: A fortress of gem rises where you point, and no foe inside moves like they did outside. For 10 seconds a zone of 5 blocks radius at the aim point deals 3.5 damage every second to enemies, holds them down with Slowness IV (Slowness II on bosses), and gives you and your allies Resistance II. Radius and damage scale with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.ideal_closer: The grimoire glows, and corundum climbs over the mage until only a Y-shaped slit remains for the eyes and mouth. The armour has arms and legs of its own and strikes whatever stands near. For 20 seconds you gain Resistance III, Absorption IV and Strength II, are slowed slightly by the weight, deal 5 extra melee damage and reflect 2 damage to attackers, and every second the armour's limbs hit all enemies within 3.6 blocks for 6 damage and knock them back. Damage and reach scale with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.star_corundum: A star sapphire, six rays of light locked in blue stone, and from it a mending glow. Everyone allied within 8 blocks, you included, heals 30 percent of maximum health, gains Regeneration II for 10 seconds and Absorption II for 20 seconds, and has Weakness removed. It can be used once in five minutes (a daily page).
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_shards: The grimoire sheds a handful of crystal splinters, each one sharp as a cut gem. Fires 5 shards in a fan, 4 damage each, scaled by Existence Points; every hit slows the target for 1.5 seconds and bleeds a little of its magicules.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.prism_beam: Light pours through a crystal and comes out as a lance. A beam 26 blocks long hits up to 4 enemies for 9 damage and blinds them for 2.5 seconds, then splits at the first foe it strikes into up to 3 weaker rays that find other enemies within 9 blocks for 5 damage and 1.5 seconds of blindness. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.shatter_burst: The target's skin clouds over with crystal, and then it comes apart. After a short half-second the target takes 12 damage (18 if it is Glowing from the scope or a Crystal Strike) and bleeds magicules, and the splinters hit every other enemy within 4.5 blocks for 6 damage and Weakness for 4 seconds. Barriers and spell projectiles within 3 blocks are broken.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_cage: Tinted crystal rises from the ground and closes over the head of the target. A single target within 18 blocks is held in place with extreme Slowness and Weakness for 3.5 seconds (shorter on bosses), takes 6 damage, and is walled in by a temporary cage of tinted crystal. It shares the hard control cooldown.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.prism_step: You become a ray of light bent through a crystal. Dash up to 10 blocks forward, passing through everything on the way: foes along the path take 7 damage, are blinded for 2 seconds and slowed for 1.5 seconds. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_scope: The grimoire builds a helm of crystal with twin telescopes and a speaking tube, so you and your friends see what is far away. For 20 seconds you and allied players within 32 blocks gain Night Vision, every enemy within 48 blocks (up to 16, nearest first) is outlined with Glowing, and the action bar reports the nearest foe's health, condition and distance.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_armor: Facets of crystal grow over your skin and turn the blows back on whoever throws them. For 15 seconds you gain Absorption III and Resistance, your melee hits deal 4 extra damage and attackers are cut by thorns. Extra damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_garden: Gems burst out of the ground like a field of frozen flowers. At the point you aim at (up to 24 blocks), a 5 block radius zone lasts 5 seconds; each second it hits enemies inside for 4 damage, slows them for 2.5 seconds and bleeds their magicules, and raises amethyst clusters on the ground that vanish after 2.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.prism_dome: A dome of cut crystal closes round you, and light bends instead of landing. For 7 seconds a 6 block dome at your feet reverses every enemy projectile that enters (it becomes yours), blinds enemies inside for 2 seconds every second, and grants you and your allies inside Resistance.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.grand_prism: All the light in the grimoire is gathered into one flawless crystal and released at once. After a 1 second charge a beam 36 blocks long and 3.6 wide deals 26 damage to everything on its line, blinds for 5 seconds, applies Weakness II for 5 seconds, jams magic (Magic Jamming) for 3 seconds and bleeds 3 percent of their magicules, and shatters barriers where it ends. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_resonanc: The grimoire strikes one clear note, and every crystal for ten paces rings with it. Three pulses in 2 seconds in a 10 block radius: enemies take 6 damage per pulse and are slowed, with Weakness II on the last; allies in range are healed by 30 percent of their max health and gain Absorption II and Regeneration II. Usable once every 10 minutes.
nusmp.page.book_curse.aufwachen_dachs: Wake, badgers: they crawl out of the open grimoire already dripping venom, and they do not stop for armour. Looses 4 poison badgers (5 at high EP) that home on the nearest foes within 18 blocks. Each deals 3.5 damage, Poison for 5 seconds, Slowness for 2 seconds, gnaws 2% of the victim's magicules and lays 1 Hex Mark.
nusmp.page.book_curse.withering_hex: A hex whispered at one face and meant for the soul behind it. Hits one target within 18 blocks for 5 damage and 2 Hex Marks, deals 3 spiritual damage (1 on bosses), saps strength with Weakness for 10 seconds and shrinks maximum life by 15% for 30 seconds. Repeated casts stack the loss up to 50% (15% on bosses).
nusmp.page.book_curse.sekke_poison_lizar: A lizard of dark bronze slips out of the book and runs on its own errand. It crawls after the one target you aim at within 22 blocks and bites on arrival for 9 damage and 2 Hex Marks, with Weakness II for 8 seconds, Slowness II for 5 seconds and Poison II for 6 seconds, then 1.5 damage every second for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.ash_absorbing_form: Streams of cursed ash run from the mage's open hands and feed on whatever they touch. For 5 seconds, every half second, up to 4 foes within 12 blocks take 1.6 damage, lose 2% of their magicules to you and are weakened; you recover a little life whenever the ash drinks, and each stream lays a Hex Mark every 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.joyful_destructive: The ash laughs as it falls, and then it laughs again. Throws a bolt of ash that bursts where it lands (radius 4.2): 5 damage, Blindness for 2.5 seconds and 1 Hex Mark, then 1.2 seconds later a second blast in the same place deals 11 damage, Wither II for 3 seconds and another Hex Mark.
nusmp.page.book_curse.curse_workers_neig: A curse-worker keeps a cursed neighbour close, to be drunk from. Tethers one target within 18 blocks (the tether holds to 26): it gains a Hex Mark if it has none, and for 6 seconds, every half second, takes 1.5 damage and Poison while 2% of its magicules, plus 0.8% per Hex Mark, flow to you; allies within 8 blocks receive 40% of what you take. A new mark is laid every 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.hex_aegis: A ward of black script that bites back. For 12 seconds you and your allies within 6 blocks take 20% less damage, and whoever strikes a warded one gets 1 Hex Mark, Weakness for 4 seconds and Slowness for 2 seconds (once a second per attacker). Casting it also lifts poison, wither, weakness, slowness, Hex Marks and shrunken life from you and your allies.
nusmp.page.book_curse.cursed_step: You step through the air and the air stays rotten behind you. Dashes up to 9 blocks forward, hitting foes in the path for 4 damage, Slowness II for 3 seconds and 1 Hex Mark, and gives you Speed II for 4 seconds. The path stays cursed for 4 seconds: foes on it take 1.2 damage every half second and are slowed and weakened, gaining a mark every 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.dwelling_poison_cl: A fume settles over the ground and makes a home there, and nothing living is welcome in it. Raises a poison cloud (radius 6) at the aimed point for 8 seconds. Every half second up to 12 foes inside take 1.6 damage, Poison, Weakness and Nausea (bosses resist the nausea), and gain a Hex Mark every 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.ultra_giant_bull: A bull built of cursed matter, large enough to carry an army, with cannons for flanks. Allies within 5 blocks of you gain Resistance for 8 seconds. The bull charges about 20 blocks ahead, trampling each foe once for 18 damage, 2 Hex Marks and a heavy knockback, then its cannons fire at up to 6 foes within 14 blocks of it for 8 damage, 4% of their magicules (which you take) and 1 Hex Mark each; it stops at the first wall it cannot climb.
nusmp.page.book_curse.curse_epidemic: One day's curse, spent all at once and left to sicken. Strikes up to 12 foes within 16 blocks for 6 damage, 3 Hex Marks, Wither for 10 seconds, Slowness for 5 seconds and a 10% cut to maximum life for 30 seconds. For the next 15 seconds every foe you marked within 20 blocks takes 1.8 damage each second, and marked foes that fall pass the curse on. Usable once per day.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.hex_eater: A rune that eats blessings. The bolt deals 7 damage, curses the target with Weakness and Fragility for 5 seconds, and tears one beneficial effect off it and onto you (up to 20 seconds of it).
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.curse_clea: The simplest ward: a breath that lifts every curse. You and your allies within 7 blocks lose all harmful effects, the Tensura poisons and curses, frost and fire, and heal 5 percent of max health plus 1.5 per curse lifted. It fails if there is nothing to cleanse.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.rune_step: A step along a line of runes. You dash up to 9 blocks, shaking off your own curses and gaining Speed II for 4 seconds. The trail you leave holds for 3 seconds: enemies on it get Slowness III and Weakness.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.malevolent: A chanted curse that spreads to those who hear it named. One target within 24 blocks takes 9 damage, 6 spiritual damage, Weakness II, Fragility and Wither for 5 seconds and is marked Glowing; up to 8 enemies within 4 blocks of it catch a lesser Weakness, Fragility and Slowness.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.curse_tran: The curses on you and your allies within 8 blocks are lifted and laid on an enemy in sight: up to 6 harmful effects move, for up to 20 seconds (half on bosses). The target takes 3 damage per curse moved. It fails if nobody carries a curse.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.mirror_war: A ward of mirrored runes that lasts 12 seconds. Every harmful effect that lands on you is lifted at once and sent to your last attacker or the nearest enemy, blows against you are cut by 20 percent, and the attacker takes up to 6 damage back.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.unbound_sl: The curse that takes a will. One target within 20 blocks takes 4 damage, is marked Glowing and slowed hard; a mob is forced to fight the nearest enemy of yours for up to 5 seconds (1 second on bosses), a player is struck with Fear and Weakness II. Hard control: it shares the 12 second control lock.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.ward_circl: A sanctuary drawn on the ground where you aim, radius 5.5, for 12 seconds. Allies inside have every curse absorbed each second and gain Resistance and Regeneration; enemy arrows and spells that enter it are turned back on their senders (up to 6 per half second).
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.decaying_w: Strands of runes spill from you in a 7 block field for 15 seconds. They bind enemies with Slowness III, Weakness, Fragility and Magic Jamming, deal 2.5 damage every 1.5 seconds, shatter enemy barriers and dissolve enemy spell projectiles every second, and while the field holds, all damage you take is cut by 30 percent.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.exploding_: The devil power bestowed in the target is set off. For 2.5 seconds it swells, glowing, slowed and unable to cast, then bursts: 30 damage and 20 spiritual damage to it (14 and 4 on bosses), 14 to every enemy within 5 blocks, thrown back by the blast. If the target dies first, the burst is weaker.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.undying_cu: A curse laid on death itself, once a day. For 60 seconds, the first blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead, and then fires Regeneration III, Absorption III and a full cleanse. The curse is spent when it triggers. Cast it, and it also cleanses you and gives Regeneration II for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.chimera_claw: The chimera's paw has no patience for distance. Three claw swipes land in quick succession on one target within 5 blocks, 4 damage each (scaled by EP), and the third leaves a wound that bleeds for 5 s (1.5 damage every half second and a little magicule drain).
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.demon_porcup: The demon porcupine bristles and the air fills with quills. Fires a fan of 7 stingers (about 20 blocks), each dealing 3 damage (scaled by EP) and poisoning the target for 4 s; a target pierced by three or more quills also starts to bleed for 4 s.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.chimeras_roa: Two magic circles open behind you and the horned head of a lion forms around your outstretched arm, then it roars. Blasts a cone up to 11 blocks long for 10 damage (scaled by EP) on up to 12 foes, throws them back, makes them cower (Fear, 5 s), weakens them (Weakness, 5 s) and tears their defence (Fragility, 5 s).
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.chimera_fang: The chimera pounces before its prey can blink. You leap to a target up to 14 blocks away and bite for 11 damage (scaled by EP); it is slowed (Slowness II, 2 s), loses defence (Fragility, 5 s) and bleeds for 5 s, and the bite heals you a little.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.terror_howl: A howl that comes from somewhere below the world. Everything within 9 blocks, up to 16 foes, is gripped by Fear (up to 5 s, shorter on players and bosses), forgets its target, glows for 6 s, takes 3 damage (scaled by EP) and is shoved away. Hard control: shares the 12 s control lock.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.horned_spiri: A horned spirit beast charges through you and leaves the ground behind. Dashes up to 10 blocks hitting everything on the way for 9 damage (scaled by EP), knocking them back and up and slowing them for 1.5 s; you gain Resistance II for 3 s and Speed II for 4 s.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.chimera_hunt: The chimera marks its territory, and what is inside is prey. A hunting ground of 7 blocks opens at the aim point for 7 s: every half second enemies inside take 2.5 damage (scaled by EP, up to 10 of them), are slowed (Slowness II) and kept bleeding, and are frightened by the first pulse.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.demon_beast_: The beast aura settles over you like a second skin. For 30 s you gain Strength II, Speed I and Jump Boost II, and your melee hits deal 4 extra damage (scaled by EP).
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.underworld_h: Scales and hide, thick as a hydra's. For 15 s you gain Absorption (the level grows with your EP), Resistance II and thorns: anyone who strikes you takes 2 damage back.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.hydras_many_: The hydra of the underworld lends you its heads. For 5 s three spectral heads circle you and strike the three nearest foes within 12 blocks every half second, 5 damage each (scaled by EP): the first head poisons (Poison II, 3 s) and heals you a little, the second slows and weakens, the third opens a bleeding wound. Signature page.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.hydras_regro: Two magic circles open and the flesh closes by itself, even where a limb was lost. Heals up to 40% of your maximum health at once (the usual healing decay applies), gives Regeneration II for 8 s and washes out poison, wither, weakness, slowness, blindness, bleeding and fire. It cannot be cast while your magic currents are severed (Magic Jamming). Daily page: 3 minute cooldown.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.black_flame_b: Pitch-black embers spat out like gunfire, one after another. Fires five bullets in quick succession along your sight, 3.5 damage each; every hit sets the demon burn for 3 seconds (1.5 damage a second, ignoring fire resistance).
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.soul_scorch: A thread of black fire that eats what armour cannot guard: the soul. A beam to one target within 20 blocks: 6 damage, spiritual damage, burns 8% of its aura and bleeds 4% of its magicules, shreds its resistances with Fragility for 5 seconds, breaks barriers around it and leaves a 5 second demon burn (2 damage a second).
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.ignition_blas: Every flame has a fuse, and this spell lights it. A bolt that bursts on impact in a 3.8 block radius for 7 damage, knockback and a 3 second demon burn. Foes that are already under the demon burn are detonated for 1.8 times the damage and their burn ends.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.black_flame_p: The ground blackens, and then the sky is held up by a column of fire. Marks the aim point (within 24 blocks) with a 2.5 block ring; after 0.9 seconds a pillar erupts: 10 damage, throws foes upward and sets a 4 second demon burn (2 damage a second).
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.hellfire_wave: A tide of flame rolls out of your hands and does not break on stone or shield. Four surges in 12 blocks of range, 5 damage each, pushing foes back and leaving a 3 second demon burn (1.5 damage a second).
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.flame_step: You are the fire, and fire needs no road. Dash up to 10 blocks forward, burning everything you pass for 5 damage and a 3 second demon burn, and leaving a trail of black flame for 3 seconds that burns anyone who stands in it.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.flame_body: The body gives way to flame, and the flame gives way to nothing. For 10 seconds you are immune to fire, move with Speed II, take 40 percent less damage for 8 seconds, and burn every enemy within 3 blocks for 2 damage every half second with the demon burn.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.black_flame_t: A spiral of black fire that eats the air and everyone who breathes it. A twister for 5 seconds at the aim point with a 5 block radius: it pulls foes in (not bosses), deals 2.5 damage every half second and keeps them under the demon burn.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.black_flame_v: A wall of flame that no spell can climb. A ring of black fire around you for 8 seconds, 3.5 blocks wide: it burns whoever touches it for 1.5 damage every quarter second, destroys enemy projectiles and spell barriers that enter it, and gives you Resistance for the duration.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.demon_fire_ap: When the abyss opens, it does not do so politely. Black fire falls in eight pillars across a 10 block area around the aim point (up to 28 blocks away), one after another: each deals 11 damage, throws foes up, bites their spirit and leaves a 6 second demon burn (2.5 damage a second). Barriers in the area are broken.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.cinder_rebirt: What burns can be born again from what is burnt. Once a day: a blast of black fire in a 6 block radius for 12 damage, a 5 second demon burn and a push to every foe; you heal 20 percent of your health plus 2 for each foe caught (up to 5), cleanse poison and wither and gain fire immunity for 20 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_shar: Seven splinters of cursed ice fan out faster than the eye can follow. Each shard deals 3.5 damage (scaled by EP), slows the target for 2 s and leaves a little frost on it; point blank, every shard lands.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_lanc: A lance of black ice pierces the world in one breath and ignores what stands in the way. Hits every foe in a 26 block line (up to 12) for 9 damage, slows them (Slowness III, 4 s), freezes them, applies Tensura Frost and bites the spirit; it breaks enemy barriers where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_wave: A wave of frost rolls out of the grimoire and nothing in front of you stays warm. In a 9 block cone it deals 8 damage, throws foes back, slows them (Slowness III, 5 s) and freezes them for about 2.5 s; up to 16 targets.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_soul: The cold reaches past flesh to the soul and shuts it in a block of ice. One foe within 18 blocks takes 6 damage and a spiritual wound, is stopped in ice for up to 3 s (hard control, 12 s shared lock, shortened on bosses), then the ice cracks for 8 more damage. Needs a target.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_shat: What is frozen is already broken, it only waits for a hand to finish it. Every fully frozen foe within 12 blocks (up to 10) takes 16 damage, thaws and is left fragile (Tensura Fragility, 4 s). Nothing happens, and nothing is spent, if no foe is frozen.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_wall: A wall of blue ice climbs out of the ground between you and the dark. Raises a wall 6 blocks wide and 4 high for 10 s; foes within 3.5 blocks of its foot are slowed (Slowness III, 4 s), frozen and shoved back.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_slid: The frost takes you, and for a breath you are only motion on ice. You dash up to 10 blocks, cutting through foes for 6 damage and slowing them; the frost left on your starting spot keeps slowing anyone who follows for 2 s.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_body: Your body turns to demon ice: hard, cold and unwelcoming. For 20 s you gain Resistance II and Absorption II, your melee hits deal +4 damage and chill the target, and anyone who strikes you is slowed and frozen.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_bliz: A blizzard that was never of this world howls at the point you name. For 7 s a 7 block storm cuts everything inside for 2.5 damage twice a second, keeps it slowed (Slowness IV) and frozen, and puts out fires; up to 24 targets.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_zero: The air around you stops moving. Everything within 9 blocks takes 14 damage, is slowed (Slowness V), frozen solid (stopped for up to 2.5 s when your control lock is free, bosses far shorter), hit with Tensura Frost and hurt in the soul, while barriers break; 3 s later the ice bursts for 10 more damage. Costs 35% of your magicules.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_wint: A winter that does not end settles on the land. For 15 s, 14 blocks around where you stand: each second every foe takes 4 damage, is slowed (Slowness IV) and frozen, loses fire, a little aura and any hostile magic in the zone breaks. Once per in-game day.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.light_sword_: Shards of black light, four lines running through each, rise beside the caster and are thrown at the target one after another. 5 to 8 shards (by existence points) each deal 3 damage and 1.5 spiritual damage and blind for 1.5 seconds; they home on the target you look at. Undead and demons take 60 percent more and burn.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.blinding_fla: The caster opens the grimoire and the dark light blooms all at once. Everything within 7 blocks takes 3 damage, is Blinded and Glowing for 5 seconds, and hunting mobs lose their target (not bosses).
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.bright_judgm: A lash of bright judgment cracks across the room and wraps what it finds. The whip reaches 12 blocks and lashes twice: each lash deals 4 damage and 2 spiritual damage, drags the target toward you and weakens it for 3 seconds. Needs a target in reach.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.prism_breake: A beam that does not care for walls of magic. It runs 22 blocks, shatters hostile barriers, jails and spell projectiles along its length, and hits everything on the line for 6 damage and 3 spiritual damage, burns 10 percent of the aura and jams magic (Silence) for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.purging_ligh: Holy fire in a dark colour. Within 7 blocks undead and demons lose every beneficial effect, take 6 damage and 3 spiritual damage and burn; other foes take 2 damage and are blinded for 2 seconds. You and your allies are cleansed of poison, wither, weakness and blindness.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.light_prison: Bars of black light close around one target. For up to 4 seconds (shorter on players and bosses) it cannot walk (Slowness X), jump or see (Blindness), loses its hunting target, takes 3 damage and 1 spiritual damage every second. Hard control: shares the 12 second control lock.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.light_step: The caster turns into a line of light. A dash of up to 14 blocks hits everything on the path for 5 damage and blinds it for 3 seconds, then you run with Speed II for 6 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.veil_of_blac: A film of dark light as bright as a mirror hangs on the caster. For 8 seconds you have Resistance I and Absorption II, and every arrow, bolt or spell projectile that comes within 3.5 blocks is thrown back at the shooter.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.eclipse_doma: A black sun hangs over the point you look at. For 6 seconds, in a 6 block radius, foes are blinded, slowed (Slowness II), take 2.5 damage and 1 spiritual damage every half second (undead and demons take more and burn), and your allies inside gain Regeneration.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.light_shaft_: The light gathers between the caster's hands until it is a great sphere, then falls as a column too fast and too wide to avoid. After a 1.2 second charge a column 4.5 blocks wide strikes the point you looked at: 14 damage, 6 spiritual damage, 6 seconds of Blindness and 5 seconds of fire, it shatters barriers, and an aftershock hits again for 5 damage. Undead and demons take 60 percent more.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.demon_dawn: For a moment the demon light is a sunrise. Every foe within 12 blocks is blinded and glows for 10 seconds and is weakened (Weakness II); undead and demons also take 8 damage and 4 spiritual damage. You and allies are cleansed, healed (30 percent of max health for you, 20 percent for allies), and gain Regeneration II and Absorption II. Cooldown 10 minutes.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.tidal_push: The black water rises in front of the caster and shoves everything back. A cone of 9 blocks deals 6 damage, throws foes away and a little up, and slows them (Slowness III) for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.dark_tide_wa: A flat wall of dark water runs down the hall like a flood. A 16-block line, 2.2 blocks wide, deals 9 damage, shoves foes along, slows them for 2.5 seconds and strikes 3 spiritual health, which ignores armour (not on bosses).
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.drowning_gra: Water gathers inside the target's lungs and does not leave. For up to 4 seconds (shorter on players and bosses) the target is crawling (Slowness V) and weakened, loses its air, and takes 3 damage every half second plus 1 spiritual damage. Hard control: shares the 12 second control lock.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.healing_mist: Not all of the dark water is cruel. A cool teal mist spreads 8 blocks around the caster and closes wounds: you and your allies are healed 15 percent of max health, gain Regeneration II for 5 seconds, and lose poison, slowness and fire.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.serpent_surg: The caster becomes a serpent of the deep and darts through the air. A dash of up to 9 blocks hits everything on the path for 6 damage with a push and a 2 second slow, then grants Water Breathing for 20 seconds and Dolphin's Grace for 6 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.abyssal_ward: A shell of pressure from the deep sea wraps the body. For 12 seconds you have Resistance II and Water Breathing, your melee hits deal 4 extra damage, and attackers are lashed back for 2 damage.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.abyssal_whir: A black whirlpool opens at the point you look at, 5 blocks wide, and does not let go. For 5 seconds it drags everything toward its centre, slows it (Slowness III), and tears at it for 3 damage every second. Bosses are pulled only a little.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.hydra_of_dar: The caster raises a great sphere of water, and from its surface eyeless, spiked serpents rise to crush the target in their sharp-toothed mouths. 3 to 5 serpents (by existence points) leave the sphere one after another and hunt the nearest enemies: each hit deals 7 damage, 3 spiritual damage, Slowness III and Weakness II, and drains the target's air. The serpents live about 1.2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.tide_rebirth: The water that took so much gives back. You and allies within 6 blocks lose every harmful effect and are healed (50 percent of max health for you, 25 percent for allies), with Absorption II for 30 seconds and Regeneration II for 10 seconds. Cooldown 10 minutes.
nusmp.page.book_gel.sticky_gel: A glob of thick gel, thrown to cling. The glob deals 6 damage and Slowness III for 4 seconds on a direct hit; where it lands it spreads into a pool (radius 2.4, 4 seconds) that keeps everyone inside slowed and deals 1.5 damage every half second, while it neutralises poison on you and your allies.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_burst: The gel swells around the mage and bursts outward, flinging everything off its feet. Enemies within 4.5 blocks take 11 damage, are thrown away and upward, and are left slowed (Slowness II, 3 seconds); bosses are only nudged.
nusmp.page.book_gel.bouncy_gel_pad: A springy cushion of gel, set where you aim. For 10 seconds a pad (radius 2.4) throws you and your allies high into the air and cancels the fall damage; enemies that step on it are tossed up about a block and land without that protection.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_smother: Gel poured over one target until it cannot move or breathe. A hard control (shares the control cooldown): the target is held in gel for up to 4 seconds (Slowness VI, Tensura Webbed, Weakness II, Blindness), takes 5 damage on cast and 3 every half second after; bosses are held for 1 second and take less.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_antidote: The gel is permeable, and it drinks poison. Everyone friendly within 7 blocks of you is cleansed of vanilla and Tensura poisons, healed for 12 percent of their maximum health and given Regeneration for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_gel.absorbing_gel: A skin of gel soaks up the force of every blow. For 10 seconds you take 50 percent less damage (70 percent less from projectiles, which are swallowed within 2.4 blocks), gain Absorption, and heal a little of what the gel soaks up; melee attackers get stuck in Slowness II.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_skin: Your body turns as springy as the gel itself. For 30 seconds you have Resistance, Jump Boost II and no fall damage, and every melee hit leaves its target stuck in Slowness II for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_mire: The ground turns to a vat of slow, clinging gel. A field (radius 6, 8 seconds) at the aim point drags every enemy toward its centre, holds them in Slowness IV, deals 2.5 damage every half second and cleanses poison from you and your allies.
nusmp.page.book_gel.sticky_salamander: A salamander made of nothing but gel, steered by the mage's gestures. For 10 seconds it hunts the nearest enemy (or follows your aim), grabs up to two targets in Slowness VI (the first is webbed fast when the control cooldown allows), deals 3.5 damage every half second, cleanses poison from friends it passes and carries loose items to you when it dissolves.
nusmp.page.book_gel.huge_sticky_salamand: The same salamander at many times the size. For 12 seconds it grows to over twice the length, grabs up to six enemies at once in Slowness VI, deals 7 damage every half second, drags them toward its body and carries any loose items back to you when it dissolves.
nusmp.page.book_gel.jelly_cocoon: Once a day, the gel wraps you whole. You are cleansed of poison, healed for 40 percent of your maximum health and given strong Absorption and Resistance II; for 8 seconds the cocoon also halves incoming damage and negates falls, and enemies within 4.5 blocks are shoved away and stuck in Slowness III.
nusmp.page.book_glass.shard_volley: A fistful of glass shards, flung in a fan before they can catch the light. Fires 5 shards (3.5 damage each, scaled by your EP) in a narrow fan; every shard that hits leaves 1 glass cut, a bleed that stacks up to 8.
nusmp.page.book_glass.glass_lance: A lance of glass, thin enough to vanish edge-on and long enough to run through a whole line of foes. Fires a fast piercing lance (10 damage, scaled by your EP) that leaves 2 glass cuts and Fragility for 4 seconds on everything it passes through.
nusmp.page.book_glass.verre_epee: Glass Magic: Verre Epee. A blade of glass grows along the arm, light as air and sharp as a razor, and the mage moves faster for it. For 30 seconds your melee hits deal 4 extra damage (scaled by your EP) and leave a glass cut each, and you gain Speed I.
nusmp.page.book_glass.pane_step: The mage steps into one pane of glass and out of another further on, cutting everything between. Moves you up to 9 blocks forward; everything along the path takes 5 damage (scaled by your EP) and 1 glass cut, and you keep Speed II for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_glass.verre_detection: Glass Magic: Verre Detection. With the grimoire open, panes of glass are spread over the area and the light passing between them finds anyone hiding. Everything within 24 blocks (scaled by your EP) loses invisibility and glows for 12 seconds, through walls, and the number of presences found is shown to you.
nusmp.page.book_glass.prism_barrier: A pane of glass stands between the mage and the world and gives back what it is given. For 8 seconds incoming damage is cut by 40 percent, melee attackers take 35 percent of the blow back as thorns damage (at most 20) and are slowed, and projectiles that come within 2.8 blocks are turned around and become yours.
nusmp.page.book_glass.glass_shatter: A single sharp note, and every cut in the room opens at once. Everything within 8 blocks of the aim point (scaled by your EP) takes 3 damage plus 4 per glass cut it carries, and loses those cuts; enemy barriers, jails and spell projectiles in range are broken too.
nusmp.page.book_glass.shard_rain: The ceiling of the sky turns to glass, and the glass falls. For 5 seconds, over a circle of 5.5 blocks (scaled by your EP) at the aim point, shards fall every quarter second on up to 3 enemies in it, each dealing 2.8 damage (scaled by your EP) and 1 glass cut.
nusmp.page.book_glass.verre_fleur: Glass Creation Magic: Verre Fleur. The mage throws both hands to the sky and blade-like spikes of glass rise from the ground, big and small, folding together into the shape of a flower. Three waves of spikes burst at the aim point, growing outward to a radius of 5 blocks (scaled by your EP): 6, 7 and 8 damage, 2 to 3 glass cuts each and a throw into the air.
nusmp.page.book_glass.le_chateau_de_verr: Union Magic: Le Chateau de Verre. A castle of glass rises around the mage, with great glass flowers floating over its walls (the steel half of the original union is not part of this spell). A ring of glass panes 3 blocks high, radius 7 (scaled by your EP) with a gate in front of you, stands for 10 seconds; enemies inside take 4 damage and 1 glass cut every half second and are slowed and made to glow, while you and your allies inside gain Resistance and Regeneration.
nusmp.page.book_glass.crystal_carapace: The mage is sealed in a shell of crystal that shatters outward at the first sign of danger. Once a day: heals 30 percent of your health, grants Absorption IV for 30 seconds, Resistance II and the prism reflection for 10 seconds, and bursts shards over everything within 5 blocks (8 damage, scaled by your EP, and 3 glass cuts, thrown back).
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_volley: Wedge Volley - five small wedges leave the page in a fan, each one keen as a nail of ice. Each wedge deals 4 damage (scaled by EP), slows the target for 2.5 s and leaves a little frost on it; stand close and every wedge lands.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_driver: Wedge Driver - the mage steps in and hammers a wedge straight into a foe, and the ice does not come out again. One foe within 7 blocks takes 9 damage (scaled by EP), is slowed hard (Slowness IV, 4 s), loses 4% of its maximum magicules and is chilled by frost; a foe that is already frozen takes 13.5.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_fan: Wedge Fan - the wedges are spread like the ribs of a fan and swept across the ground. Every foe in a 9 block cone takes 9 damage (scaled by EP), is slowed (Slowness III, 4.5 s) and freezes for about 3.5 s.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.splitting_wedg: Splitting Wedge - a wedge is driven in and the foe can go nowhere. Pins one foe within 18 blocks for up to 3.5 s (it cannot move; bosses and repeated pins are cut short) and deals 5 damage, then the wedge splits: 11 damage to the pinned foe and 6 to everyone within 3.5 blocks, all of them slowed and frozen. Hard control: it shares the 12 s control lock.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.frost_brand: Frost Brand - frost gathers along the mage's hands like a brand pressed into the blade. For 20 s your melee hits deal 4.5 extra damage (scaled by EP), slow and freeze the target and bleed 1% of its magicules, and you gain Speed I.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_aegis: Wedge Aegis - a ring of wedges stands around the mage, points out. For 15 s you gain Resistance I and Absorption II, projectiles that come within 4 blocks are broken, and whoever strikes you is slowed (Slowness III, 3 s) and frosted.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_wall: Wedge Wall - two rows of packed ice are driven up in a V, the point aimed at the enemy. Raises a 7 wide, 3 high wall for 10 s ahead of you; foes at its point are slowed (Slowness III, 4 s) and chilled.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_step: Wedge Step - the mage rides a wedge of ice, comes down behind the foe and drives it home. Teleports behind the foe you are looking at (up to 16 blocks), dealing 8 damage (scaled by EP) to those on the path, slowing the foe (Slowness III, 4 s) and chilling it. Fails if no one is in sight.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_field: Wedge Field - the ground cracks and wedges thrust up through it, again and again. For 8 s, in a 6.5 block circle at the aim point, every second hits each foe for 3 damage (scaled by EP), slows it hard (Slowness IV) and keeps it frozen.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.world_end_mart: World End Martyr - from the open grimoire a giant of razor ice rises, winged like an angel, two halos over its head and a cross for a face. For 6 s it stands at the aim point: its rising breaks hostile barriers within 12 blocks, every half second it looses freezing beams from its head at the three nearest foes within 18 blocks (6 damage each, scaled by EP, Slowness IV and heavy frost) and its talons stamp everything within 5 blocks every 1.5 s for 8 damage and a shove. Costs 35% of your magicules.
