nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.world_end_chur: World End Church - the mage takes the mana around them and raises a church of ice, and the cold falls to absolute zero. For 15 s inside 15 blocks every second each foe takes 4 damage (scaled by EP), is slowed (Slowness IV), frozen and frosted, loses 2% of its maximum magicules, fire is put out and hostile barriers are broken; eight pillars of blue ice stand around you. Once a day. Lava is not turned to stone.
nusmp.page.book_key.skeleton_keys: A ring of thin skeleton keys fans out from the grimoire and hunts for locks to open in flesh. Three homing keys fly out in a fan, each hits for 4 damage (scales with your EP) and slows the target (Slowness I, 1.5 seconds).
nusmp.page.book_key.janus_baptism: A key slides into the air before the foe and turns, and the foe's magic goes cold and grey like stone. The key lock hits for 5 damage, locks the target's magic for 5 seconds (a player's grimoire is sealed, silence and a magic jam are applied; bosses only 1 second), adds Slowness II and Weakness for the same time, and steals 6 percent of its magicules for you. Each cast stores one stolen charge (up to 4) that Janus Abigail spends as an extra door. Range 16 blocks.
nusmp.page.book_key.keyhole_prison: The foe is met by a keyhole in the air and drawn in, and nothing outside knows where it went. The target is frozen in stopped time, invisible and silenced for up to 3.5 seconds (hard control, shortened on players and bosses, shares the control cooldown), then the key turns and it is thrown out for 14 damage (scales with your EP) with a knockback. Range 16 blocks.
nusmp.page.book_key.door_step: A door opens where you point and another where you stand, and you simply walk from one to the other. You teleport up to 14 blocks along your gaze, through thin walls, to the farthest free spot, and take no fall damage. Foes within 3 blocks of the exit are slammed by the door for 4 damage, Slowness II for 2 seconds and a knockback.
nusmp.page.book_key.master_key: The master key fits every lock, and the hand that holds it moves quickly. For 18 seconds you gain Speed I and Haste II, and every melee hit adds 4 damage (scales with your EP) and locks the target's legs and magic: Slowness II and silence for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_key.bolted_door: A heavy door falls shut around you and every bolt slides home. For 8 seconds you have Resistance II and an absorption shell, enemy projectiles within 3.5 blocks are destroyed, and foes who come inside are pushed back (bosses only lightly).
nusmp.page.book_key.unlock: The key turns the other way and every lock that held your friends falls open. Within 6 blocks you and your allies lose every harmful effect, ice, stopped time and a sealed grimoire, are immune to stopped time for one second and heal 12 percent of their health (healing decay applies). Up to 12 allies.
nusmp.page.book_key.locked_domain: A room with no door is drawn at the spot you aim at, and all its keyholes face inward. For 7 seconds a field of 5.5 blocks slows foes inside (Slowness IV, bosses Slowness II), silences them and locks the grimoire of players, cuts them for 2.5 damage a second (scales with your EP) and shatters magic barriers inside it every 2 seconds. Range 20 blocks.
nusmp.page.book_key.key_armory: Keys of every size rise in a crown behind you, point first, waiting for a lock. For 8 seconds one golden key-spear every 0.6 seconds flies at the nearest foe within 16 blocks, homing, for 4 damage (scales with your EP) and Slowness II for 1 second. Needs a foe in range to start.
nusmp.page.book_key.janus_abigail: The space behind the doors opens and everything it holds comes out at once: stolen fire, ice, lightning and wind, from every side. Six doors (plus one per stolen charge from Janus Baptism, up to ten) open in a ring above you and loose one after another a bolt of 7 damage at your target: fire (burning 4 seconds), ice (frozen and Slowness II), lightning (silence and Weakness) and wind (lifts the target). Damage scales with your EP. Range 40 blocks.
nusmp.page.book_key.doom_s_gate: The forbidden spell: the mage pays all they have left, and a gate of doom opens in front of them. You pay 60 percent of your current health (never below 1 heart; you need at least 5 hearts) and a quarter of your magicules, and suffer Weakness II and Slowness II for 15 seconds. After 2.5 seconds the door looses a beam 44 blocks long and 3 blocks wide for 30 damage, with a 7 block blast at its end for 18 damage and a knockback, and it shatters magic barriers on its path. Once a day.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.sticky_tar: A glob of tar, thrown to cling. On a direct hit it deals 5 damage, Slowness III for 5 seconds and soaks the target; where it lands it spreads into a tar pool (radius 2.2, 6 seconds) that keeps everyone inside in Slowness III, soaked in oil, and pressed down so they cannot leap out.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.curse_filled_n: With an open grimoire, the oil takes the shape of long fingernails on your hand. Reach someone within 5 blocks: the nails rake them for 7 curse damage, Slowness II and Weakness for 4 to 5 seconds and soak them in oil, then tell you their health, magicule and body temperature. The curse stays in the wound: 2 curse damage and a drain of magicule every second for 4 seconds (less on bosses).
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.oil_slick: Oil sprayed from the palm in a wide fan. Everything in the cone (8 blocks) takes 4 damage, Slowness II for 6 seconds and is soaked in oil for 12 seconds, ready for the flame; the ground in front of you is left slick.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.ignite_oil: A spark, and every oil-soaked enemy within 16 blocks goes up at once. Each soaked target explodes for 12 fire damage (half again as much for the oil on it) and burns for 6 seconds; enemies within 3 blocks of a blast take 6 fire damage and burn for 3 seconds, and the blast throws them back. Fails if nothing is soaked.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.oil_slide: You skate forward on a slick of your own oil. A fast dash of about 10 blocks with Speed II for 3 seconds and no fall damage; the path you take is left as oil pools (about 6 seconds) that keep enemies who touch them in Slowness III and soaked.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.oil_soaked_arm: The oil coats your arms to the shoulder. For 30 seconds you have Strength, every melee hit deals 3 extra damage, and each target hit is gummed (Slowness II for 2.5 seconds) and soaked in oil for 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.viscous_coat: A thick skin of oil that nothing gets through cleanly. For 10 seconds you take 40 percent less damage (50 percent less from projectiles, which are also slowed to a crawl within 3 blocks of you); melee attackers are left in Slowness III and soaked in oil.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.tar_pit: The ground turns to a pit of tar. A zone (radius 5, 8 seconds) at the aim point holds every enemy in Slowness IV, soaked in oil, dragged toward its centre and pushed down so they cannot jump, and deals 2 damage every half second.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.curse_candle_r: A ritual disk is drawn at your feet and six black candles are lit around it. For 12 seconds every enemy inside (radius 6) takes 2.5 curse damage a second, Weakness, Slowness, Fragility and a drain of magicule, and each cursed enemy (up to 3) feeds you 1 health a second while you stand inside.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.black_oil_erup: A well of black oil bursts from the ground, and then it catches. At the aim point enemies within 6 blocks take 12 damage, are thrown into the air (bosses barely) and left soaked and in Slowness IV; two seconds later the geyser ignites for 18 fire damage (half again as much for the oil), burning for 8 seconds, followed by 3 seconds of flames on the ground that deal 3 fire damage every half second.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.black_oil_sea: Once a day, the oil rises into a lake around you. For 15 seconds everything within 11 blocks of where you stood is in Slowness III and soaked in oil and takes 2 damage a second, while you and your allies skate over it with Speed II and Resistance.
nusmp.page.book_body.bullet_fist: The legs coil and let go, and the whole body is the bullet. Nothing in the way keeps its footing. You lunge about 7 blocks forward in 7 ticks; each foe you pass takes 8 damage (35% of its armour ignored), is shoved back and lifted, and is slowed (Slowness II, 1.5 s). You take no fall damage while lunging.
nusmp.page.book_body.rapid_barrage: Five fists in under a second, all into the same few places that hurt. The first four are only a warning. Needs a target within 6 blocks: five jabs, one every 3 ticks, four of 2.8 damage and a last one of 6 (40% of armour ignored, ignores the hit-immunity of the earlier jabs); the last jab knocks the foe back and gives it Weakness for 4 s (1.5 s on bosses).
nusmp.page.book_body.body_compression: The forearm is condensed and restructured from the inside until it is a gun barrel, and what the mage feeds into it leaves faster than the eye can follow. After a 6 tick forming, three piercing rounds fly 4 ticks apart (34 blocks, 6.5 damage each, the last packed double for 11 and a heavy knockback); each shot kicks you slightly back.
nusmp.page.book_body.tendon_sever: A thumb pressed in the right place and the leg simply stops listening. Armour does not matter to a tendon. Needs a target within 8 blocks and uses the shared control lock: 5 damage (60% of armour ignored), Slowness VI, Weakness II and Mining Fatigue II for up to 3.5 s (1 s on bosses) and a 4% bleed of the foe's magicules.
nusmp.page.book_body.hardened_frame: Bone is packed tighter, muscle is drawn like cable, and blows begin to ring off the body rather than into it. Costs Aura (8%) on top of the page: for 20 s physical damage you take is cut by 30% and magic damage by 15%, you gain Absorption II (4 hearts), and the muscle layer of Body Magic shows on your skin.
nusmp.page.book_body.tissue_mend: Flesh is only a habit the body keeps; call it back and it knits. Wounds close, burns cool, poison runs out. You and every ally within 5 blocks heal 25% of max health (the usual healing decay applies), gain Regeneration II for 8 s, are put out and lose every harmful potion effect.
nusmp.page.book_body.leg_spring: Legs wound like a spring, then released. The ground takes the weight when you come back down. Costs Aura (4%): you leap about 8 blocks high and 5 forward, take no fall damage, and on landing everything within 4.2 blocks takes 9 damage, is shoved away and lifted, and is slowed (Slowness II, 2 s).
nusmp.page.book_body.quake_stomp: One heavy step, and the earth answers in rings, each one breaking the ground a little farther out. The stomp sends five shock waves outward over 15 ticks to 6 blocks (scales with mana zone); every foe the wave reaches once takes 7 damage, is thrown outward and up, slowed (Slowness III, 3 s) and dizzied (Nausea, 3 s; 1 s on bosses).
nusmp.page.book_body.titan_form: Every muscle in the body is condensed and then released at once, and the mage stands a head taller with steam pouring off the skin. Costs Aura (15%): for 20 s you gain Strength II, Resistance II and 6 extra hearts; melee blows deal +6 damage and shake every foe within 2.5 blocks of the target for 3 and a shove. The cast itself throws foes within 4 blocks back for 6 damage. When the form ends you are slowed (Slowness II) and weakened for 4 s.
nusmp.page.book_body.flesh_regrowth: Even a lost limb is only tissue that has not yet been told to grow. The body is made to remember what it was. Once a day: you heal half of your max health at once, then Regeneration III for 12 s and Absorption III; allies within 8 blocks heal 30% with Regeneration II and Absorption II. Everyone touched loses every harmful potion effect and is put out. Once a day.
nusmp.page.book_briar.thorn_lash: A vine grows from your hand and cracks like a whip, hooking its prickles into flesh and dragging the victim in. Hits everything within 8 blocks in a line for 6 damage, poisons for 3 seconds, cuts a little of the target's magicules and yanks it toward you (not bosses).
nusmp.page.book_briar.creeping_vines: The ground where you point splits and wild vines crawl up legs. A 3.2 block patch pulses twice, one second apart: 3 damage, Slowness V with the stride cut, and poison, on everything in it. Bosses are slowed less.
nusmp.page.book_briar.bleeding_thorn_wal: A hedge of briar roots erupts in front of you, red with the blood of those who tested it. Raises a 7 wide, 3 high wall for 11 seconds, throws back and wounds the enemies nearby (3 damage, poison), then every half second tears anyone touching it for 1.5 damage, poison, Slowness II and a cut in their magicules.
nusmp.page.book_briar.rose_scent: The roses breathe a sweet perfume that dulls every sense. Within 7 blocks, enemies get Blindness for 4 seconds, Nausea for 5, Weakness for 6 and Magic Jamming for 5 seconds. On bosses these last about a third as long.
nusmp.page.book_briar.thorn_reflect: A dress of briars grows over you, and whoever strikes it is pricked in turn. For 20 seconds you gain Resistance, take 15 percent less from every enemy blow, and each attacker takes 40 percent of that blow as thorn damage (at most 8) and is poisoned for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.briar_leap: You throw a vine at the point you look at and let it haul you across. Launches you up to 22 blocks toward the aim point with Slow Falling, snares enemies at your feet (4 damage, rooted) and bursts into thorns where you land (5 damage, poison, rooted for 1.5 seconds in 3 blocks).
nusmp.page.book_briar.briar_garden: A wild thicket of roses blooms where you look, beautiful and merciless. A 5.5 block field lasts 10 seconds and every half second deals 1.5 damage, poison and Slowness III to enemies inside, cutting their magicules every second.
nusmp.page.book_briar.corpse_hunting_bri: You unsheathe your weapon and it becomes prickle-covered vines that hunt your targets across the field. They seize up to 4 of the nearest enemies within 20 blocks, rooting them (Slowness X, held about 3 seconds, shortened on bosses), then converge into a tall briar tree that rises through them for 14 damage and a toss, followed by 2.5 damage, poison and a magicule cut every half second for 2.5 seconds. Needs the control lock.
nusmp.page.book_briar.queen_of_briars: A natural mana array blooms real roses and you wrap yourself in a dress and crown of briars, red roses on the left, blue on the right, a whip in your hand. For 60 seconds you gain Resistance, Regeneration and thorn reflect, and your melee hits add 3 damage, poison and a magicule drain. On cast the whip lashes enemies within 8 blocks: red roses deal 8 damage, poison and a bleed; the strongest of them is wrapped in blue roses that hold harder the greater its power (Slowness and Weakness, drained). Needs the control lock when enemies are near.
nusmp.page.book_briar.rose_garden_bloom: Once a day the land around you remembers it was a wilderness and blooms into a briar field. For 20 seconds, within 9 blocks, enemies take 3 damage, poison, root and Magic Jamming every second and lose magicules to you, while you and your allies heal 3 percent of their health each second.
nusmp.page.book_copper.conduction_arc: Conduction Arc - copper carries a charge from one body to the next, and the mage only has to touch the first. Hits the foe you look at (18 blocks) for 7 damage (scaled by EP), then jumps to the nearest other foe within 6 blocks, up to 5 foes in all, each jump 15% weaker. Every foe hit is slowed (Slowness II, 2 s) and has its magic jammed (Magic Jamming, 1.5 s).
nusmp.page.book_copper.red_shine_mace: Red Shine Mace - the mage draws a huge polearm out of glowing copper, its head the size of an anvil, and brings it down on the enemy. The mace lands after half a second on the target (or the aim point, 14 blocks): every foe within 3.2 blocks takes 14 damage (scaled by EP) with half of their armour ignored, is knocked back, slowed (Slowness III, 3 s), weakened (Weakness, 4 s) and made to glow (4 s).
nusmp.page.book_copper.copper_wire_bind: Copper Wire Bind - thin copper wire flies from the fingertips and wraps limbs tighter than rope, and it is as good a conductor as it is a binder. Binds the foe you look at (16 blocks) and up to two more within 4.5 blocks of it: they cannot move (Slowness X, 2.5 s, shorter on repeat and on bosses), take 4 damage (scaled by EP) and lose 2% of their magicules. Hard control: shares the 12 s control lock.
nusmp.page.book_copper.verdigris_blight: Verdigris Blight - the mage lets the copper age in a heartbeat, and green rust creeps over whatever it touches. At the aim point (16 blocks) a 4.5 block field bursts for 5 damage (scaled by EP) and pulses once a second for 4 s for 2.5 each; foes inside are poisoned (3 s), corroded (Corrosion, 5 s) and made fragile (Fragility, 5 s), so their armour and resistance give way. Bosses keep the effects for a third of the time.
nusmp.page.book_copper.rail_dash: Rail Dash - a strip of copper unrolls under the mage's feet and the current carries them along it. Dashes up to 11 blocks forward, shocking everything on the line for 6 damage (scaled by EP), knocking it aside, slowing it (Slowness II, 1.5 s) and jamming its magic (1.5 s). Afterwards you keep Speed II for 3 s.
nusmp.page.book_copper.galvanic_edge: Galvanic Edge - the mage's weapon and fists hum with stored charge, and every blow lets some of it run free. For 15 s your melee hits deal 4 extra damage (scaled by EP), and each hit arcs 4 damage (scaled by EP) to the nearest other foe within 5 blocks, slowing it (1.5 s). You also gain Haste I for the duration.
nusmp.page.book_copper.copper_plating: Copper Plating - plates of copper grow over skin and cloth, each one welded to the next. For 15 s all physical damage you take is cut by a third (magic is not), you gain 4 hearts of Absorption, and every attacker that strikes you is shocked for 3 damage and slowed (1 s).
nusmp.page.book_copper.copper_bulwark: Copper Bulwark - a wall of cut copper rises out of the ground, still warm and humming. Raises a wall five blocks wide and three high, 2.5 blocks in front of you, for 10 s (only on free space; it is removed afterwards). Foes within 3.4 blocks of it are shocked every second for 2.5 damage (scaled by EP) and slowed (Slowness II, 2 s).
nusmp.page.book_copper.conduction_field: Conduction Field - the ground turns to a plate of live copper, and anything standing on it becomes part of the circuit. At the aim point (20 blocks) a field of 5.5 blocks radius lasts 6 s; every second it shocks up to 8 foes inside for 3.5 damage (scaled by EP), slows them (Slowness II, 1.5 s) and, on every second pulse, jams their magic (2 s). Lines of current visibly link the foes together.
nusmp.page.book_copper.copper_tempest: Copper Tempest - a single rod of copper is driven into the earth, and the sky answers it three times. At the aim point (22 blocks) a rod stands for 5 s: foes within 7 blocks are dragged toward it, and at 2 s, 3 s and 4 s a bolt falls for 13 damage (scaled by EP) to up to 10 foes, slowing (Slowness III, 2 s) and jamming their magic (4 s), with current running from the rod to each. The last bolt paralyses (about 2 s, hard control, shorter on bosses).
nusmp.page.book_copper.plating_restorati: Plating Restoration - the mage beats the dented plates flat again and polishes them bright. Once a day: you and allies within 8 blocks heal 30% of maximum health (healing decay applies), gain 6 hearts of Absorption for 20 s and are cleansed of poison and wither, and your own Copper Plating is renewed for 15 s.
nusmp.page.book_eye.piercing_glance: Nothing hides from a glance that has already decided where to land. Strikes the first target in sight within 28 blocks for 7 damage and makes it glow for 5 seconds; an invisible target is revealed and takes 50% more (10.5). Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.seeker_eyes: Four small eyes slip out of the grimoire and follow the magic of whoever is nearest. Each flies at speed 1.25, homes on the closest enemies within 16 blocks and hits for 5 damage, blinds for 2 seconds and bleeds 1% of the target's magicules. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.mark_of_sight: A mark burned into the sight of the world: the target can no longer be lost. Marks one target within 32 blocks for 12 seconds: it glows through walls, loses invisibility and takes 25% more damage from you and your allies. Deals 2 damage on cast.
nusmp.page.book_eye.blinding_flash: The eyes open wide and the light inside them is too much to look at. Everyone in front of you within 9 blocks takes 4 damage and is blinded for 6 seconds (bosses 1.5 seconds), and monsters lose their target on you. Needs at least one enemy in the cone. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.evil_eye: A long look that takes more than it shows. One target within 24 blocks takes 4 damage, Weakness II for 12 seconds, Slowness and Mining Fatigue for 6 seconds and Fragility (lower resistance) for 6 seconds, and you drink 5% of its magicules (1% from bosses).
nusmp.page.book_eye.keen_sight: Sharpen the eyes until the dark is only another colour. For 30 seconds you gain Night Vision and Speed, and your melee hits deal 3 extra damage scaled by Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.iris_ward: A wide iris opens around the mage and shows every shot its own aim. For 8 seconds enemy projectiles that enter 4.5 blocks around you (up to 14) are turned back at whoever fired them and become yours, and that shooter is jammed (Magic Jamming) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eye.sight_step: Where the eyes can see, the body can already stand. Teleports you to the spot you are looking at, up to 16 blocks away and never through a wall, resets fall damage and gives Night Vision for 5 seconds. Up to 8 enemies along the path are revealed and glow for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eye.field_of_eyes: The ground opens a hundred lidless eyes, and none of them blink. A 6 block zone at the target point lasting 8 seconds: every 0.5 seconds up to 12 enemies inside take 1.5 damage, glow, get Weakness, are jammed (Magic Jamming) and lose 0.5% of their magicules. Invisible enemies are revealed.
nusmp.page.book_eye.reflect_iris: Union Magic: an array of mirrors turns round the mage, and anyone who looks into it sees their own eyes looking back. For 6 seconds, up to 8 enemies within 8 blocks who look at you are paralysed for up to 2.5 seconds (bosses 1 second) with their magic blocked for 3 seconds longer, then struck by Reflect Refrain for 14 damage scaled by Existence Points. Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_eye.all_seeing_eye: The mage opens the eye that never closes and the whole country lies open. For 30 seconds you have Night Vision, everything alive within 40 blocks glows through walls (invisible ones too), and up to 40 are tracked. Foes within 20 blocks stay marked and take 25% more from you and your allies. Daily: 10 minute cooldown.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.sniper_eye: One eye hangs far ahead, watching the muscles of the prey, and fires when the step is already decided. Hits the first target within 40 blocks instantly for 8 damage, or 12 if it is moving or falling, and slows it (Slowness I) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.roving_eyes: Four small eyes slip from the grimoire and wander after the nearest enemies. Fires 4 homing eyes that deal 5 damage each on hit and apply Slowness II for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.petrifying_gaze: A stare that does not blink turns the blood to stone. The first target within 22 blocks takes 3 damage and is paralysed for up to 3.5 seconds, with Slowness X, no jumping and Mining Fatigue for 2 more seconds. Hard control: shares the 12 second control lock, shortened by repeats, a quarter on bosses.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.magicule_scan: The eyes spread out like a net and read every magicule signature around you. Every enemy within 20 blocks (up to 16) glows through walls for 10 seconds and loses 3 percent of its magicules (0.5 percent on bosses). You gain Night Vision for 12 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.eye_swap: You see through the eye on the enemy, and for a breath that is where you stand. You and the target within 20 blocks trade places; it takes 2 damage, is blinded for 2 seconds, slowed (Slowness II) for 3 seconds and forgets its aim. Fails without room on both sides and never works on bosses.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.sight_share: Your eyes become everyone's eyes. You and allies within 16 blocks (up to 8) gain Night Vision for 60 seconds and Speed I for 30 seconds, and every enemy within 30 blocks glows for 10 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.guardian_eyes: Eyes circle you, blinking, and nothing slips past them. For 10 seconds enemy projectiles and spells entering 4 blocks are shot down (up to 24), you gain Resistance I, and enemies near you are slowed (Slowness II) every half second.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.scouting_eyes: You leave eyes in the air and walk away, still watching through them. For 25 seconds a 14 block circle at your aim point makes every enemy inside glow and be weakened (Weakness I), and gives allies inside Night Vision.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.jamming_gaze_fie: A great eye opens above a circle of ground and nothing under it may cast. For 10 seconds, every half second, enemies within 6 blocks (up to 12) take 2 damage and Slowness III; those the eye can see (no wall between) are also silenced and have their Ultimate skills jammed. Break line of sight to avoid the jamming.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.catoblepas_s_evi: Eyes spread over the whole field and the prey is read: its magic, its stamina, its next step. For 10 seconds, every second the 5 nearest enemies within 20 blocks are revealed and sniped for 5 damage (7.5 if moving), slowed (Slowness II) and bled of 1 percent of their magicules. On the last pulse they are paralysed for up to 2.5 seconds. Hard control: shares the 12 second control lock. You gain Night Vision.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.swarm_of_eyes: A cloud of tiny eyes flies around you, and each one finds a victim. For 12 seconds, five times a second, one eye picks a random enemy within 22 blocks for 3 damage and Slowness I. Once a day.
nusmp.page.book_food.fork_skewer: A fork as tall as a doorway, thrown point first. It pierces every enemy in a line (9 damage, range about 29 blocks) and leaves each one bleeding magicules (5% of their pool), while the first three skewered feed you 1.5 health each.
nusmp.page.book_food.carving_cleave: A carving knife the size of a plank sweeps across the table and everything on it. Enemies in a wide cone 5 blocks long take 12 damage, bleed 4% of their magicules, are knocked back and suffer Weakness for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_food.pie_barrage: Five pies fly out one after another, each one aimed at a different face. Every pie homes on the nearest enemies for 5 damage, covers them in cream (Slowness II for 3 seconds) and blinds non-boss targets for 1 second.
nusmp.page.book_food.rotten_feast: Leftovers forgotten for a month, served with a smile. A spoiled dish (6 damage) bursts where it lands into a stinking cloud of radius 3.2 that lasts 4 seconds: every enemy inside takes 2.5 damage every half second and is given Hunger III, Poison II, Weakness and, unless it is a boss, nausea.
nusmp.page.book_food.starving_rush: The hungry mage lunges across the room straight for the plate. Dashes up to 9 blocks forward, biting every enemy on the way for 8 damage and recovering 2 health for each one hit.
nusmp.page.book_food.hearty_meal: A hot plate set in front of every friend at the table. You and your allies within 8 blocks recover 25% of their maximum health, are fed (8 food points), regain 4% of their magicules and gain Regeneration for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_food.full_stomach: A full belly is the best armour there is. For 30 seconds you gain Strength, Resistance and Absorption III, your food bar is filled, and 60% of the damage of every projectile that hits you is eaten, healing you for half of what was eaten. Allies within 5 blocks share half the duration with weaker Absorption.
nusmp.page.book_food.silver_platter: A great silver dish lifted in front of the mage, to catch whatever is thrown. For 5 seconds every enemy projectile and spell shot that enters 3.4 blocks of you is eaten, healing you 2 health and restoring 3% of your magicules each (up to 6 per half second), and you gain Absorption II.
nusmp.page.book_food.banquet_table: A long table unrolls across the ground, laden to the edges. For 8 seconds, once a second, you and your allies inside the 5 block circle recover 4% of their health, are fed and regain 1.5% of their magicules, while enemies in the circle are stuffed and sluggish (Slowness and Weakness).
nusmp.page.book_food.glutton_s_banquet: With the grimoire open, a giant wolf rises with a fork and a knife, stabbing the spells in the air and dragging them into its mouth. For about 3 seconds a feeding zone of radius 5.5 eats every enemy projectile (5% of your magicules and 2 health each) and breaks enemy magic constructs, then the wolf bites: enemies within 4.5 blocks take 14 damage and lose 12% of their magicules to you, you heal 3 per victim, and every spell eaten adds Absorption for 20 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_food.midnight_feast: When the house is asleep, the grimoire sets one last, impossible feast. Once a day: you and allies within 12 blocks have hunger, poison and nausea washed away, recover 50% of their health and are fed to the brim, regain 25% of their magicules and gain Regeneration for 10 seconds, and Absorption III and Strength for 30 seconds, then a second helping 3 seconds later heals 20% more.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.spore_burst: A swollen puffball, lobbed and left to split open. It flies up to 24 blocks and bursts on contact in a 2.6 block cloud: 5 damage and Poison for 5 seconds, then the cloud lingers 3 seconds, re-poisoning, weakening and siphoning a little magicule from everyone inside.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.mycelium_roots: White threads race through the soil ahead of you and snag every ankle in their way. A 10 block row of roots deals 3 damage, then holds those caught in Slowness IV for 4 seconds, re-applied for 3 seconds while the roots hold; bosses are only slowed lightly.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.heavy_mr_mushroom: You press spores onto the target, and a tired old mushroom sprouts on it and keeps growing, heavier by the second. After 1 second the target is slowed more every quarter second, up to Slowness X, dragged to the ground and left mining-fatigued, then crushed for 12 damage when the pin ends (up to 4.5 seconds, shorter on players, repeats and bosses). Hard control: shares the control cooldown.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.running_mr_mushro: A little mushroom with surprisingly good legs, carrying you ahead of the spores. You dash up to 9 blocks forward, dealing 5 damage, Poison and Slowness to everything on the way, gain Speed II for 6 seconds, and leave a mycelium trail that re-poisons and slows anything crossing it for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.talking_mr_mushro: The mushroom never stops talking, and for once that helps: it knows who is hiding where and where each of them is soft. Every enemy within 22 blocks (up to 16) is outlined with Glowing for 10 seconds and gains Fragility for 5 seconds, and you are told how many there are and how far the closest is.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.spore_armor: A thick coat of fine spores clings to you and sprouts back at anything that touches it. For 20 seconds you gain Resistance and take 15 percent less from melee attackers, who are poisoned and weakened (Poison II for 5 seconds), and your own melee hits poison for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.mushroom_wall: Giant stems and caps burst from the ground in a line, thick enough to stop a charge. A five wide, three tall wall of mushroom blocks stands for 10 seconds in front of you; enemies near it are shoved back and poisoned for 3 seconds. Blocks never grow around someone standing in the way.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.mycelium_mending: The same threads that bind can stitch: mycelium knits flesh and draws out poison. You and your allies within 7 blocks heal 18 percent of maximum health (the usual healing decay applies), gain Regeneration for 5 seconds and are cured of Poison.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.spore_cloud: A great grey-brown cloud rolls out and does not lift for a long time. At the aimed point (up to 20 blocks) a 5 block cloud lasts 8 seconds: every half second it deals 1.5 damage and applies Poison II and Weakness, and every second it siphons 1 percent of each victim's magicules into you.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.towering_mr_mushr: Open the grimoire and the ground swells: a giant king oyster with arms, legs and a face rises and does not look pleased. After 1.2 seconds it erupts at the aimed point (up to 24 blocks), dealing 16 damage in 3.5 blocks, throwing enemies up, poisoning them and rooting them; for 6 seconds its arms slam everything within 4.5 blocks every second for 6 damage, a shove, Poison II and a 1 percent magicule siphon, while a tall stem and cap of mushroom blocks stands for 7 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.mycelium_bloom: Once a day the whole forest floor remembers it is alive. For 20 seconds a 9 block fungal forest blooms around where you stand: every second enemies take 3 damage, Poison II, Weakness and Slowness III and lose 2 percent of their magicules to you, while allies inside heal 3 percent of maximum health. Usable once per in-game day.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_bullet: The mage wraps a large iron casing round one arm and thrusts it at the target; mana tears it loose and it explodes on contact. Flies up to 16 blocks, then bursts in a 2.5 block radius for 10 damage, knocks enemies back and weighs them down (Slowness II and Burden) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_shrapnel: A fist of iron is shattered in the grimoire's face and the pieces fly like a shotgun blast. Hits every enemy in a 7 block cone for 6 damage; the splinters slow them (Slowness II) for 2 seconds and bleed 1.5 percent of their magicules.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_sword_rain: Iron swords hang over the field, then fall one after another like a hard rain. Eight blades drop at random points within 4 blocks of the aimed spot (up to 22 blocks), each hitting everything within 1.8 blocks for 6 damage and slowing it (Slowness II) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_shackles: Iron cuffs close round the wrists and ankles of the target, heavy enough to pin a giant. The target within 16 blocks takes 5 damage, is rooted (Slowness X), weighed down (Burden II) and Weakened for up to 4.5 seconds (players 3 s, bosses 1 s). Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_charge: The mage becomes a cannonball of iron and goes straight through whatever is in the way. Dashes up to 9 blocks forward, hitting everything on the path for 8 damage, knocking it aside and weighing it down (Slowness II and Burden) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_fist: Iron grows over the knuckles until each punch lands like a forge hammer. For 20 seconds your melee hits deal 4 extra damage and you gain Resistance I.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_wall: A slab of solid iron rises in front of the mage, as wide as a doorway and thrice as tall as it needs to be. Raises a wall of iron blocks four wide and three high 2.5 blocks ahead, which sinks back into the ground after 8 seconds. Only fills empty space.
nusmp.page.book_iron.immovable_guardian_: A great metal bell, its outside carved with a guardian figure, comes down over the mage and nothing gets in. For 8 seconds you and your allies within 3.5 blocks gain Resistance III, you gain Absorption II (and Slowness I as the price of standing still), enemy projectiles in the bell are destroyed, and enemies touching it are shoved away and take 2 damage each second. Like the original it is not a defence against spatial magic.
nusmp.page.book_iron.rust_field: Iron that is left alone rots, and the mage speeds it up a thousandfold. For 7 seconds every enemy within 5 blocks of the aimed point (up to 20 blocks) is slowed (Slowness II), Weakened, weighed down (Burden) and its defences corrode (Fragility, where Tensura has it); each second it takes 3 damage and loses 1 percent of its magicules.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_god_of_war: The mage is sheathed in the iron body of a war god taller than any gate, and the ground trembles at each step. At the cast a slam hits everything within 6 blocks for 14 damage and slows it. For 12 seconds you gain Resistance III, Strength II and Absorption III, and every second your stomp hits all enemies within 5 blocks for 5 damage, slows them (Slowness III) and throws them back. The wiki gives no details of this spell, so this is an honest reading of its name.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_anvil: An anvil the size of a house is forged in the sky and let go. After 1 second it lands on the aimed point (up to 24 blocks) and crushes everything within 5 blocks for 24 damage, tosses it up, and weighs it down with Slowness IV and Burden II for 5 seconds. Once per 5 minutes.
nusmp.page.book_legion.pawn_march: Five pawns line up and march forward as one rank. They advance 8 blocks in a second; everyone they meet is hit once for 5 damage, shoved back and left in Slowness II for 2.5 seconds. The lead pawn stays standing at the end of the road for 10 seconds as a soldier you can swap with.
nusmp.page.book_legion.muster_soldiers: The mage raises a ring of soldiers around themselves and lets them guard. Four soldiers (more with high EP) stand 3 blocks out for 30 seconds; every half second each one cuts down enemies within 3 blocks for 2.5 damage and Slowness for 1.5 seconds. Each enemy is hit once per pulse.
nusmp.page.book_legion.knight_gambit: A knight moves as the piece does: two squares one way, three the other, then a charge. It rides in an L around the target and crashes into it for 11 damage, throwing it up and back and leaving Weakness and Fragility for 4 seconds. The knight stands beside the target for 15 seconds as a soldier you can swap with. Bosses take half damage.
nusmp.page.book_legion.soldier_snare: Three soldiers surround one enemy and grip it. A hard control (shares the control cooldown): the target is held under Slowness X and Weakness for up to 4 seconds (shortened for bosses and repeated holds) and takes 4 damage. The three pawns stay standing for 2 seconds longer.
nusmp.page.book_legion.commanders_banner: A banner goes up and the mage commands the field. For 30 seconds your melee blows deal 3 more damage, and you and every ally within 8 blocks gain Speed and Resistance for 20 seconds. A pawn stands guard beside the banner for 30 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_legion.rook_barricade: Rooks pile up into a wall of stone brick in front of the mage: five blocks wide and three high, vanishing after 10 seconds. You gain Resistance for 8 seconds and Absorption for 10 seconds, allies within 6 blocks gain Resistance, and two rooks stand at the ends of the wall for 15 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_legion.blink_castling: Castling, as the chess rule says: the mage and a soldier trade squares. You swap places with the soldier closest to where you look (1.5 to 48 blocks), the soldier takes your old spot, you gain Resistance III for a second, and every mob hunting you within 16 blocks loses its target. It cannot be cast with no soldiers standing.
nusmp.page.book_legion.gehenna_game: A round chessboard unfolds at the aim point and the pieces come to life. For 8 seconds, on a board 7 blocks wide, eight pieces circle the board, and every half second enemies near a piece take 3 damage and Slowness II; everyone on the board is held in Slowness for the whole game. The pieces count as soldiers you can swap with.
nusmp.page.book_legion.legion_chessboard: Toggle Legion's floating chessboard from the Tensura Unique-skill menu or this page. The effect appears behind your summoned grimoire and fades out when disabled.
nusmp.page.book_legion.endless_dominatio: The mage's legion rises without end. Eight soldiers orbit you at 4 blocks for 15 seconds; every half second enemies within 3 blocks of a soldier take 4.5 damage and Slowness II, and every 3 seconds the soldiers lunge at the four nearest foes within 20 blocks for 7 damage each, with Fragility and Weakness for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_legion.end_empress: Every soldier you have stands together and merges into one colossus. After a moment's gathering it slams down at the aim point: everything within 8 blocks takes 16 damage plus 3 for each merged soldier (up to 8), is thrown up, and is left in Slowness III and Fragility for 5 seconds. The giant then stands for 8 seconds, stomping every second for 6 damage within 6 blocks. A daily spell, usable once per day.
nusmp.page.book_beast.spirit_beast_summo: A beast of living flame steps out of the grimoire: a spectral lion-wolf with a ragged flame mane. It runs at your side and pounces on the nearest hostile within 12 blocks, biting for 7 damage (scaled by EP) and slowing what it hits, for 20 to 30 s (longer with EP). From 3.5x EP a spirit bear joins it and from 6x a spirit rhino. Casting again calls the pack anew.
nusmp.page.book_beast.primal_beast_form: The beast inside breaks the surface. For 30 s fur, ears, a flaming tail and claws grow over you: Strength II, Speed II and your melee hits deal 4.5 extra damage (scaled by EP). Cast while sneaking it becomes the great-beast shape: a ghost beast head and shoulders hover over you, the bonus is 6 and you gain Resistance I. Signature page; the older Beast Form page stays as it was.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.ideal_closer_fi: A gauntlet of ruby and sapphire as big as a cart rises beside you, draws back in front of the foe you are looking at and punches it. The blow deals 14 damage and throws the foe back and slows it (Slowness III, 3 seconds); you can call it twice in 12 seconds, and the second one is a sapphire hammer-fist that deals 12 and also shoves everything within 3.4 blocks for 7. Damage, size and how long the gauntlet hovers scale with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.gem_plate_armou: Faceted red and blue corundum plates grow over your shoulders, chest, forearms and shins, and gem shards circle you. For 20 seconds you gain Resistance III and Strength, and every shard darts at the nearest hostile within 12 blocks, piercing everything in its path for 3.5 damage and Slowness II. A well-mastered grimoire (or a devil state) also grows a crystal crown and wings of shards; the shard count, damage and duration scale with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_key.gate_of_keys: A tall gate of violet stone and gold rises out of the ground ahead of you, its keyhole alight, and its doors swing open on a well of stolen magic. For 8 seconds (longer with more EP, up to half again) it turns to the nearest foe within 14 blocks and looses a bolt every half second for 4 damage (scales with your EP; bosses take half): fire (burning), ice (frozen and slowed), lightning (silenced and weakened) or wind (lifts the foe), and the element changes with each cast. Needs a foe within 16 blocks; a new gate replaces the old one.
nusmp.page.book_key.key_guard: Three great keys with gem-set bows leave the grimoire and circle you like a guard, and a golden-violet keyhole glows on your back with three small keys orbiting your body. For 15 seconds (longer with more EP, up to half again) each great key stabs the nearest foe within 12 blocks of you for 5 damage (scales with your EP; bosses take half), slows it (Slowness II, 1.2 seconds) and knocks it back a little. Needs a foe within 16 blocks; a new cast replaces the old guard.
item.nusmp.gale_feather.desc: Sylph's wind-spirit feather. Use it: Gale Leap, a gust flings you forward and up and slows your fall for 8 s (12 s cooldown).
item.nusmp.magic_stone.desc: One of the ancient Magic Stones. Use it (Arcane Stage only): negative mana for 60 s, spells +60% power and -30% cost, every cast corrupts you.
key.nusmp.djinn_down: Djinn: Lower Phase / Release Extreme Magic
item.nusmp.quicklings_ivy.card: Requires attunement. A +1 finesse rapier: +1 attack damage and a little more attack speed. Every hit bites for 1d4 more poison damage. Sprout Ivy (the worn-relic key; six a day, fifteen seconds apart, the 2 per short rest of the card): the next hit within ten seconds sprouts a tangle of ivy that restrains the target. It must beat a Strength save (DC 16) or it is rooted, and it saves again every second for up to three seconds (one on a boss). A critical hit sprouts the ivy for free. Tensura: Sprout Ivy lends Sticky Steel Thread for ten seconds and the ivy adds Tensura's Webbed. The blade's own right-click Ensnaring Ivy, Thorn Flurry and engravings are unchanged. Tabletop became: a d20 save against the target's toughness (knockback resistance, health, armour toughness, +4 on a boss), a round is a second, a short rest is a cooldown.
item.nusmp.quicklings_ivy.desc: A +1 finesse rapier whose every hit bites for 1d4 more poison. Sprout Ivy readies the next hit to restrain its target (a Strength save each second); a critical hit sprouts it free.
item.nusmp.magebane_longsword.card: Requires attunement (any caster: here, anyone). A +2 blade (+2 attack damage). A blow on a creature that is casting (using an item) breaks it off, and a blow on one that holds a buff makes it save against Constitution with disadvantage (DC 10 or half the damage): on a failure it loses a buff, its skills are jammed and Tensura's Magic Interference lands on it. When any creature within 3.5 blocks begins a skill or a spell, the wielder strikes it as a reaction (once every three seconds). Set bonus, with the Magebane Shield attuned too: Dispel Magic once until the next dawn (the worn-relic key): on the creature you aim at or, with no one aimed at, on everything within 8 blocks, it strips every buff (the weak ones for sure), erases spell bolts and wards, jams skills, and lends Magic Jamming and Chant Annulment for thirty seconds. Tensura: Magic Sense is lent while it is wielded. The blade's own Dispel Surge, Spellbreak Ward and engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.magebane_longsword.desc: A +2 blade that breaks the concentration of the casters it cuts, and strikes at any caster who begins a spell next to you. With the Magebane Shield it can Dispel Magic once a day. Lends Magic Sense.
item.nusmp.magebane_shield.card: Requires attunement (any caster: here, anyone). +1 armour while held. Advantage on saves against spells: spell damage from a caster within five blocks is a fifth less, and a harmful effect from one is shrugged off more often (a save with advantage, DC 14). Tensura lends Magic Resistance while it is held. Absorb Elements (once until the next dawn, automatic): the first elemental blow (fire, cold, lightning) of the day is halved, the matching Tensura resistance skill is lent for thirty seconds, a Tensura Magic Barrier rises for ten, and your next melee hit returns 3d6 of that element. Set bonus, with the Magebane Longsword attuned too: when a spell or blast of 6 or more hurts you, you cover behind the shield (once until the next dawn): with the shield raised you take nothing, otherwise an even chance of nothing and else half. The shield's own blocking, Spellbreak Parry, Absorb Surge, the one-third magic cut and engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.magebane_shield.desc: +1 armour while held; spells and afflictions from casters within five blocks are shrugged off more often; the first elemental blow of the day is absorbed and returned. With the Magebane Longsword it can cover you from a blast. Lends Magic Resistance.
item.nusmp.bolt_thrower.card: Requires attunement. A crossbow of force: +2 attack damage, and every bolt (and the Thrower's Mark discharge) hits for 2 more force damage, plus 1d8 against a construct (a golem, a colossus, a statue). It needs no loading and no ammunition (as before). Tensura lends Farsight while it is held (the +2 to hit became sight). The Force Bolt, Triple Volley, Thrower's Marks and engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.bolt_thrower.desc: A crossbow of force: +2 on every bolt (and on a blow of the frame), 1d8 more against constructs, and it never needs loading. Lends Farsight.
item.nusmp.brooch_pin.card: A dagger that folds into a brooch. Drawn in the hand it is a +1 dagger (+1 attack damage). Worn in a Curios slot and not drawn it passes for jewellery: creatures see you a quarter less well and Tensura's Presence Concealment is kept on you (the disadvantage on checks to tell it is a weapon). Unfolding is taking it from the Curios slot into the hand and folding is putting it back. The Piercing Pin, Ruby Ward, Backstab and engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.brooch_pin.desc: A dagger that folds into a ruby brooch: drawn in the hand it is a +1 dagger; worn in a Curios slot it passes for jewellery, and creatures see you a quarter less well.
item.nusmp.club_of_rot.card: A critical hit (a blow struck while falling) adds 2d6 necrotic damage, not to the dead or to constructs, and the target must save against Constitution (DC 15) or be sickened (Weakness II and Mining Fatigue, the disadvantage on attacks and checks); it saves again every second. Tensura lends Poison Resistance while it is held. Putrid Slam, Plague Cloud, the Rot that every hit inflicts, and the engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.club_of_rot.desc: A critical hit adds 2d6 necrotic damage (not to the dead or to constructs) and sickens the target unless it saves against Constitution each second. Every hit still rots. Lends Poison Resistance.
item.nusmp.crossbow_of_swift_death.card: Requires attunement. A bolt that strikes a surprised creature (asleep, struck from behind, or hunting someone else or no one) lands as a critical hit: 60% more damage. The creature must save against Wisdom (DC 12) or be frightened (a mob drops its target and runs, a player is slowed, Tensura's Fear lands on it), and saves again every second; a boss is only weakened. A frame found in the world carries 3d6 notches (+1% crit chance each, to +20%). Tensura lends Coercion while it is held. The crit and execution rules, the notch for every crit kill, Death Mark and the engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.crossbow_of_swift_death.desc: A bolt that finds a surprised creature (asleep, struck from behind, or hunting someone else) lands as a critical hit and may terrify it. A frame found in the world carries 3d6 notches. Lends Coercion.
item.nusmp.doom_hammer.card: A blow that leaves a living creature (not undead, not a construct) under 35% of its health marks it doomed for eight seconds: it can not be stabilised, so it mends half as much, and Tensura's Curse lands on it. Under 25% the hammer adds 5d6 necrotic damage on top (it may well kill). Doom Slam, Sentence of Doom, the armour break and the engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.doom_hammer.desc: A blow that leaves a living creature under a third of its health marks it doomed (it mends half as much); under a quarter, the hammer adds 5d6 necrotic damage on top.
item.nusmp.weapon_of_resurgence.card: Requires attunement. A +1 weapon that bonds with a paladin: attunement is the bond, and Tensura's Self Regeneration is lent while it is held. Every hit still returns a point of the Lay on Hands pool (three on the wicked). Lay on Hands (the worn-relic key): spends up to 10 points of the pool to mend the ally you look at (or yourself) 2 hit points a point, and 5 more lift an affliction. Resurgent Smite, Chains of Sanctity and the engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.weapon_of_resurgence.desc: A +1 paladin's blade: every hit refills a point of its Lay on Hands pool, and Lay on Hands spends the pool to mend an ally or cleanse an affliction. Lends Self Regeneration.
item.nusmp.hand_of_providence.card: Requires attunement; worn in the Curios hands slot. Tensura lends Holy Resistance while it is worn. Mage Hand (the worn-relic key): a spectral hand, shaped by your god, fetches every dropped item and orb of experience within 12 blocks (up to 16) to you, and lends Gravity Manipulation for twenty seconds. Mage Hand: Lay on Hands: the ally you aim at up to 18 blocks away (or you) is mended for 30% of their health (at least 8), regenerates, is cleansed and gains Tensura's Healthcare: Lay on Hands through the mage hand. Held in the hand, the gauntlet keeps its healing fists, Laying On of Hands, Providence Strike and engravings.
item.nusmp.hand_of_providence.desc: A gauntlet with a blue cross on the back. Its Mage Hand fetches dropped items and experience from 12 blocks, and lays healing hands on an ally up to 18 blocks away. Lends Holy Resistance.
item.nusmp.devil_contract.card: Signed in blood, forever binding, one at a time. Use it as before to bargain with a devil of your grimoire (the three prices are unchanged), or sign one of the four Infernal Contracts of the card (click a term in the chat, /infernalpact, or the contract's acts). You can have only one contract or devil at a time; this is also the Devil bond of the Djinn system. Blood: your youth returns: a full heal, +2 hearts, +1 attack damage, +4% speed and +10% maximum aura. Riches: 64 Magic Stones, 8 medium and 4 high-quality crystals, 32 emeralds and 8 diamonds at once. Knowledge: Luck +2, Tensura's Sage kept lent, and the ritual Contact Other Plane (sneak and use a book, every five minutes): Sage, Analytical Appraisal and Magic Sense for a minute and every hostile presence within 40 blocks glows for ten seconds (a quarter of the time the answer is madness: nausea and weakness). Power: a 15% larger magicule pool, grimoire magic 20% cheaper, and at each new day three Tensura spells (flame, lightning, a barrier) are lent for ten minutes. Curse: Damned: when you die your soul goes into a crystal that drops where you fell; you return Soulless (30% less maximum health and weakened) until someone uses the crystal while you are in the world, or one day has passed.
item.nusmp.prism_blade.card: Requires attunement. Every hit adds 1d8 radiant damage (a swing counts once). Blinding Radiance (the worn-relic key; once a day): everything within 9 blocks saves against Constitution (DC 15) or is blinded (Tensura's Flashed Blindness too), and saves again every second. Chromatic Strike (three a day, thirty seconds apart): the next hit within ten seconds adds 4d8 radiant damage and the target saves against Wisdom (DC 15) or is frightened (or, if you were sneaking, charmed: it will not turn on you for the time it lasts). Tensura lends Light Resistance while it is held. The blade's own Blinding Flash, Chromatic Strike beam and engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.prism_blade.desc: Every hit adds 1d8 radiant damage. Blinding Radiance blinds all within 9 blocks (once a day); Chromatic Strike readies a hit for 4d8 more and a fear or charm. Lends Light Resistance.
item.nusmp.permafrost_sabre.card: Requires attunement. A +1 sabre. Cold damage is halved while it is held (and Tensura's Cold Resistance is lent). Every hit adds 1d6 cold damage and Tensura's Chill (2d6 as a set). Boreal Fusion (the worn-relic key), with the Cyclone Rapier in the other hand and both attuned: a 2.2 block whirlwind of frost forms in front of you for twelve seconds and wind and ice are lent to you (Wind Manipulation, Ice Breath). Creatures in it save against Strength (DC 16, with disadvantage within 1.6 blocks of you): on a failure 2d6 cold and 2d6 force and they are held, up to two medium creatures or one large one, and cut again every second, saving to break free. Use it again to move it up to 9 blocks toward where you aim, sneak to dismiss it. Twice a day. Whirlwind Frost, Permafrost Sweep and the engravings are unchanged. As a set the pair is Very Rare: here it earns the 2d6, Boreal Fusion and the whirlwind.
item.nusmp.permafrost_sabre.desc: A +1 sabre that halves cold damage while held and adds 1d6 cold to every hit. With the Cyclone Rapier in the other hand: 2d6, and the Boreal Fusion whirlwind. Lends Cold Resistance.
item.nusmp.cyclone_rapier.card: Requires attunement. A +1 light rapier (+1 attack damage, +0.3 attack speed). Every hit adds 1d6 force damage (2d6 as a set). Boreal Fusion (the worn-relic key), with the Permafrost Sabre in the other hand and both attuned: the whirlwind of frost, as on the sabre. Cyclone Thrust, Gale Lance and the engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.cyclone_rapier.desc: A +1 light rapier, quick in the hand, that adds 1d6 force to every hit. With the Permafrost Sabre in the other hand: 2d6, and the Boreal Fusion whirlwind.
item.nusmp.bloodbound_katana.card: Hits on a living creature (not undead, not a construct) store Blood Charges, up to 10 (the item's own rule, now with the dead and the made giving none); every charge bites on every blow (+0.8 damage). Blood Sip (toggle, the worn-relic key): while on, each hit costs you 1d4 health (never leaving you under two hearts) and gives one more charge, and Tensura's Drain is lent. Bloodflare (toggle): while on, each hit spends three charges for 1d8 necrotic damage, twice a hit at most. A full blade (10 charges) is unstable: each hit costs you a little blood. Bloodflare (right-click), Crimson Reaping and the engravings are unchanged. Tabletop became: the Charisma bonus to the maximum is the fixed ten; a free action is a toggle.
item.nusmp.bloodbound_katana.desc: Hits on the living store Blood Charges (up to 10) that bite on every blow; the dead and constructs give none. Blood Sip trades your blood for charges; Bloodflare spends three for 1d8 more.
item.nusmp.thundercleave.card: Requires attunement. A +1 greatsword with two charges (a long rest is a day: they refill at dawn, or by one every ten seconds while you hold it under an open thunderstorm). Thunder Sweep (the worn-relic key): spend a charge and the blade cuts a wide arc: up to three creatures within 3.4 blocks take 2d6 thunder damage, are pushed back and deafened (Darkness and Tensura's Silence) for two seconds. Tensura lends Electricity Resistance while it is held. Thunder Arc, Thunderstorm and the engravings are unchanged.
item.nusmp.thundercleave.desc: A +1 greatsword with two charges: Thunder Sweep spends one to cut a wide arc that strikes three creatures for 2d6 thunder, hurls them back and deafens them. Dawn, or a thunderstorm overhead, restores the charges. Lends Electricity Resistance.
item.nusmp.staff_of_moonlight.card: Crafted by the first moon elf sages, this indestructible staff is imbued with pure moonlight. Requires attunement. While you hold it: you take half damage from radiant (light) attacks, you see in the dark, and Tensura's Magic Sense is lent to you, so you feel forgotten moon temples and ancient places of power. Moon Spells: the staff holds 10 charges and regains 1d6+4 of them every dawn (a Minecraft day). Use casts the chosen spell, sneak + use chooses the next: Guiding Bolt (1 charge: a radiant bolt that marks the foe, the next blow from a player lands 3 harder), Moonbeam (2: a column of moonlight at the aimed point for 3 s), Lightwall (5: a wall of light for 8 s that stops foreign missiles and shoves foes back, with Tensura's Ranged and Multilayer Barrier lent for as long), Sunbeam (6: a beam of light 20 blocks long that scorches and blinds everything in it, the undead worse), Star Crown (7: for 9 s stars strike the nearest foe each second and you wear 4 hearts of shield, with Magic Aura lent). If you spend the last charge there is a 1 in 20 chance the moonlight gutters out: the staff is dark through the next dawn (it is never destroyed). Tabletop rules replaced: the d20 destruction became the guttering; the light cantrip became Night Vision while held; spell save DC and attack bonus became fixed damage.
item.nusmp.staff_of_moonlight.desc: A silver staff crowned with a crescent that cradles a full moon. It lights the dark and halves radiant harm. Ten charges of moonlight cast Guiding Bolt, Moonbeam, Lightwall, Sunbeam and Star Crown, and return at dawn.
item.nusmp.liquid_sword.card: A +1 sword of crystal water. Underwater (or standing in water) its blows hit 2 harder (the +1 becomes +3), you swim with Dolphin's Grace and Tensura's Water Current Control is lent, so water fighting has no penalty. Liquid Lure (3 uses a day): the blade turns to a watery whip and drags the foe you aim at (12 blocks) to within arm's reach. Foes bigger than 2.6 blocks wide or 3.2 tall, or with 80 percent knockback resistance, slip free (the Strength save). Water Current Control and Water Manipulation are lent for 10 s.
item.nusmp.liquid_sword.desc: A blade of living water. Underwater it hits much harder and you swim as if the sea were not there. Liquid Lure turns it to a whip and drags a foe to you.
item.nusmp.marids_valor.card: A scimitar whose blade is a marid's magical water, indistinguishable from steel in its sheath. Requires attunement. Change State (use): flips the blade between SOLID (how it is found) and LIQUID. Liquid: your reach is 2 blocks longer, a blow struck while both of you are in water hits 2 harder (the sight-reliant advantage), and Tensura's Water Blade is lent. Solid: every blow bites 4 harder with cold, chills the foe (Tensura Frost, Slowness, freezing), and Cold Resistance is lent. Flash Freeze (sneak + use, solid blade only, with the tip on still water): freezes a 3 x 3 patch of the surface for one minute. Not inside the Living Dungeon.
item.nusmp.marids_valor.desc: A scimitar whose blade is a djinn's water. Liquid, it reaches 2 blocks further; solid, it bites with cold and can freeze a patch of water.
item.nusmp.catstaff.card: A magic quarterstaff infused with the spirits of heroic and feisty cats. Requires attunement; only a cat lover should wield it (cats trust its bearer). It is sentient and meows loudly when you jump. Finesse: it strikes fast (attack speed 2.0). Feline Grace: +15 percent walking speed, 4 blocks less fall damage, a fifth less damage from missiles and explosions (the Dexterity-save advantage), and Tensura's Danger Sense is lent. Cat Spells (use casts, sneak + use chooses): Jump (at will, a long leap and a meow), Speak with Cats (at will: cats within 14 blocks are befriended and mended; Thought Communication and Telepathy are lent for a minute), Feline Form (once a day: 90 s of speed, jump boost and night vision, with Tensura's Beast Transformation lent: the polymorph into a cat).
item.nusmp.catstaff.desc: A staff of the spirits of feisty old cats. Its bearer is quick and lands on their feet. It casts Jump and Speak with Cats at will, and once a day turns you into a cat for 90 seconds.
item.nusmp.rainbow_rapier.card: A +1 finesse rapier. Requires attunement. Colour Spray (once a day): a wave of colours sweeps a 8-block cone: foes in it are blinded (Blindness and Tensura's Flashed Blindness) and lit up. On a critical hit you turn invisible for 2 s (Invisibility and Tensura's Presence Concealment); it cannot happen again for 8 s. Recolour (sneak + use): one touch steps a sheep, or a block of wool, carpet, glass, concrete or terracotta, one dye round the colour wheel.
item.nusmp.rainbow_rapier.desc: A rapier whose blade runs through every colour. Once a day it sprays a wave of colours that blinds foes; a critical hit makes you vanish for a moment; sneak + use recolours what you touch.
item.nusmp.astralis_the_eye_of_the_unive: Astralis - The Eye of the Universe

A legendary staff whose gem is the eye of the universe. Requires attunement by a spellcaster. Arcana Astra: your spells (magic, elemental and holy damage) hit 15 percent harder and Tensura's Magic Aura is kept lent; and Astralis is the one relic that lets a mage hold more than one bond (spirit, devil, djinn) at once. Astral Arts (use casts, sneak + use chooses): Blinding Stars (once a day: everything within 8 blocks is scorched by light and blinded for 5 s), then Dimension Walker, 3 charges that all return at dawn: Dimension Door (1: step up to 32 blocks to where you look, to a safe landing; Spatial Motion lent), Scrying (2: every foe within 48 blocks glows for 10 s; Farsight, Magic Sense and Analytical Appraisal lent for 30 s), Planeshift (3: to your bed or the world's spawn; Spatial Manipulation lent; never in or out of the Living Dungeon). The Amulet of the Sea of Stars adds 2 charges.

A silver staff whose gem is the eye of the universe. Your spells hit 15 percent harder, it lets a mage hold more than one bond, and its Astral Arts are Blinding Stars, Dimension Door, Scrying and Planeshift.
item.nusmp.deliverance.card: A +2 longsword that fills you with a sense of justice and retribution. Requires attunement. Retribution: a fifth of every blow a foe lands on you (at most 3) returns to it as light, or as Tensura's holy damage if it is undead. Divine Smite (use, costs 8 percent of your magicules): your next blow within 8 s burns for 6 extra radiant damage (9 on the undead) and Strengthen Body is lent for the same time. For those 8 s you also have the sacred flame: sneak + use calls a flame down on the foe you aim at (16 blocks, 4 damage, holy against the undead).
item.nusmp.deliverance.desc: A teal longsword wound in green fire. Divine Smite makes your next blow burn with light, and for 8 seconds the sacred flame answers your call.
item.nusmp.wand_of_bubbles.card: Use: harmless bubbles stream from the wand. Air Bubble (sneak + use, once a day): wraps the head of a willing target (the player or pet you aim at, else yourself) in air: Water Breathing for 5 minutes, ending the moment the target takes any damage.
item.nusmp.wand_of_bubbles.desc: A wand that blows harmless bubbles. Once a day, sneak + use wraps a willing head in air: water breathing until it takes a hit.
item.nusmp.viola_of_moonlit_spirits.card: Use plays the chosen tune, sneak + use chooses the next. Spirit Performance (free, 60 s apart): played at night, three ghosts of the viola's past owners stand guard for 20 s (by day, one): each turns aside one blow from a foe, and one blow in five also frightens the attacker (Tensura Fear); Musician is lent while the strings sound. The viola holds 5 charges and regains 1d4+1 every dawn: Dissonant Whispers (1: a foe in sight takes 4 psychic damage, is slowed, weakened, frightened and shoved away), Moonbeam (2: a column of moonlight at the aimed point), Gaseous Form (3: for 8 s you are mist, unseen, drifting and hard to hurt; Wind Transform lent).
item.nusmp.viola_of_moonlit_spirits.desc: A dark viola with a crescent sound hole. Played at night, ghosts of its past owners turn aside the first blows against you. Five charges cast Dissonant Whispers, Moonbeam and Gaseous Form.
item.nusmp.book_of_mispells.card: A tome that claims to hold Message, Mage Armour, Hold Person, Speak with Dead, Ice Storm, Teleport and Wish. Use casts the chosen page and then reveals what it truly was, sneak + use turns the page. Each page may be read once a day. Message = Massage: the creature you aim at (or you) gets a pleasant backrub: Regeneration and its anger forgotten. Mage Armour = Mage Armoir: a fancy wardrobe stands beside you for 30 s, with 2 hearts of shield and Body Armor lent. Hold Person = Fold Person: the foe bends over backwards, rooted for 3 s (the big and the stubborn resist). Speak with Dead = Speak with Dad: Dad answers aloud and you get a minute of Resistance and Thought Communication (no signal outside the Overworld). Ice Storm = Ick Storm: gross sludge rains for 20 s over a 4-block radius, slowing foes. Teleport = Telepoot: a small fart noise where you look. Wish = Wash: a wet sponge scrubs away every harmful effect and puts you out if you burn.
item.nusmp.book_of_mispells.desc: A scorched spellbook that claims seven grand spells, and means something else by each. Every page may be read once a day.
item.nusmp.sand_of_the_pocket.desc: A pouch that is always full of sand. Throw a handful into the eyes of someone close: they are blinded and weakened for a round. It is also ideal for sandcastles.
item.nusmp.sand_of_the_pocket.card:
Pocket Sand (use, 15 s): throw a handful into the eyes of the nearest creature in front of you within 3.5 blocks. It is blinded (Blindness and Tensura's Flashed Blindness) and its attacks weakened for 3 seconds, half that against a boss. Creatures without eyes, like the Warden, are not affected. Sandcastle (use, 3 min): shape a perfect handful of sand into a castle: you get 4 sand.
Became: the contest of dexterity rolls is gone (the sand always lands, a boss shrugs half of it off); "disadvantage on attacks and sight checks" is Blindness and Weakness for one round.
item.nusmp.the_tome_of_wait_thats_illega: File an appeal against a harmful effect that hit you or someone near you (it costs 3% of your magicules). A d20 decides: denied (and fined by a paper imp), pending, re-rolled, granted or expedited. Beware Clause 66B.

Needs attunement and a spellcaster: each petition costs 3% of your magicules, so someone with none cannot file one. Every harmful effect that lands on a player is put on file for 10 seconds. Petition for Retroactive Nullification (use, 2 per day, 30 s): appeal the latest failure that hit you or a player within 10 blocks; if none is on file the tome stays open for 30 seconds and appeals the next one. Speak the words (the tome cannot be read silently: Silence stops it); while it is heard the tome lends you Analytical Appraisal and Sage for half a minute, and you roll a d20: 1-3 denied, and a paper imp fines you 1d6 (never your last heart); 4-9 pending review, nothing changes but your next petition rolls two d20 and keeps the better; 10-15 request processed, an even chance that the effect is undone; 16-19 petition granted, the effect is undone (it is recorded: 1 in 10, something follows up with a letter); 20 expedited, undone, and whoever caused it is weakened, slowed and silenced for a few seconds. Clause 66B: every petition has a 5% chance that a Cosmic Auditor sends you a letter. The tome sues the flame: fire damage to you is cut by 15%.
Became: failed saving throws, ability checks and spell attacks are the harmful effects that land on you or a neighbour; 30 feet is 10 blocks; advantage is two rolls, the better kept; "by a spellcaster" is the magicule cost; "cannot be sold" is flavour (no villager trade asks for relics).
item.nusmp.holy_chains.desc: Blessed gold chains. Every second they burn each evil creature (undead, daemons, devils) within three blocks of you with radiant damage.
item.nusmp.holy_chains.card:
Every second, each evil creature within 3 blocks of you takes 1 radiant damage and Tensura's Holy Damage effect: the undead, and anything named after a daemon, devil, demon, lich, vampire, wraith, ghoul, imp and the like. Never a player, never a pet.
Became: the paladin's holy symbol is the wearer, a turn is a second, "evil aligned" is the undead tag and the names above.
item.nusmp.pact_of_the_deck.desc: A 54-card pact deck, thrown as cards: the suit is the damage type, the value the damage; aces expose, jacks slow, queens throw again, kings knock down, jokers surge. Drawing the pact turns cards into magicules. It reshuffles at dawn.
item.nusmp.pact_of_the_deck.card:
The pact deck is 52 playing cards and 2 jokers and lives in this charm (no need to dismiss or summon it). +1 Luck. Throw a Card (use, 1 s): draw a random card and throw it at the nearest creature you can see along your aim within 18 blocks. Spades slash, hearts burn, clubs are force, diamonds are cold (and slow). A card from 2 to 10 deals half its value (up to 5). Ace: the target is vulnerable (+30% damage) and fragile (Tensura Fragility) for 6 seconds. Jack: its movement is halved for 3 seconds. Queen: you draw and throw another card, choosing the damage type (up to two more). King: the target is knocked down unless it saves (small creatures rarely do, bosses mostly do). Joker: a roll on the wild magic surge table: a burst of confetti, swapping places, a mending light, speed, lifting the target, a spotlight on you both, a free reshuffle, or a dizzy backfire. A critical throw (1 in 20, never against players) throws two cards. Draw the Pact (use, 1 min): draw and discard three cards like a third-level spell and the pact pays you back in magicules: 2%, plus 6% for each ace, doubled with two or more aces (the spell was free); a joker rolls on the surge table for you. The deck comes back whole at every dawn; Shuffle the Deck (use, 5 min) brings it back at once.
Became: spell slots, Charisma uses per long rest and the card-game ability checks are the deck of 54 cards per day and +1 Luck; "draw cards per spell level, two aces cast free, a joker is a wild surge, 99-00 regains a spell slot" are Draw the Pact and its magicule refund; the extradimensional deck is the charm itself; a destroyed deck is not modelled (the relic ledger keeps one copy alive).
item.nusmp.phantom_steps.desc: Your steps are half in the ethereal plane: silent, unheard by the sculk, no sting from magma or thorns, a Danger Sense for traps and a hidden presence. Click your heels to slip forward through walls and creatures.
item.nusmp.phantom_steps.card:
Needs attunement. Your steps are silent for others, raise no vibration (sculk sensors, shriekers and the Warden hear nothing), and magma blocks and sweet berry bushes do not hurt you. Tensura's Presence Concealment hides you (no trace) and Danger Sense is lent to you while you wear them: it warns of traps and ambushes. Click the Heels (use, 3 per day, 3 min): the heels lend Shadow Motion and Spatial Motion for 20 seconds and you slip up to 8 blocks forward through creatures and walls (not inside the Dungeon, whose walls hold) to the farthest safe spot, invisible for 2 seconds with 4 points of absorption for 4 seconds.
Became: moving through creatures and objects as difficult terrain, and the 1d10 force damage for ending inside an object, are a blink with a safe-landing check (you never end up inside a wall); "doesn't trigger traps" is the missing vibrations, sound and magma, plus Danger Sense, which warns you before a pressure plate or tripwire (those cannot be switched off).
item.nusmp.cloak_of_the_depths.desc: Breathe and swim like a squid (water breathing and hydraulic propulsion), reach further, and call on the tentacles: a cloud of ink to vanish in, lashing tentacles, and a grasp that roots and pulls one foe.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_the_depths.card:
Needs attunement. While worn: water breathing, a dolphin's swim speed, Tensura's Water Breathing and Hydraulic Propulsion (the tentacles that propel you) and +0.75 reach (the touch reach of the tentacles). Ink Cloud (use, 1 min): a cloud of ink 5 blocks wide: foes inside are blinded for 4 seconds, in darkness for 5 and slowed; you slip away invisible and fast for 3 seconds. Writhing Touch (use, 5 s, costs 6% of your magicules): tentacles lash the nearest foes within 6 blocks, one tentacle and one more at experience levels 10, 20 and 30; each deals 3 bludgeoning damage and slows and weakens its target for 5 seconds. Depths Grasp (use, 2 per day, 1.5 min, costs 10% of your magicules): the tentacles seize the foe you aim at (up to 14 blocks): 5 damage, rooted (Slowness, Movement Interference and Earth Lock) for 5 seconds (2 against a boss) and pulled towards you (not a boss).
Became: swim speed 30 ft is Dolphin's Grace and Hydraulic Propulsion; the Darkness spell is the ink; Earthen Grasp and Grasping Vine are one ability; Strength and Dexterity penalties are Slowness and Weakness.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_the_moth_rider.desc: Turns into a giant moth that fights beside you for five minutes, throws a terrifying face to frighten the foes around you, and, with Coercion, makes one monster in five unwilling to pick you as its first target.
item.nusmp.cloak_of_the_moth_rider.card:
Needs attunement. Flight of the Giant Moth (use, once a day): the cloak becomes a giant moth (a Tensura Hell Moth, else a giant bat, else a vex) that fights beside you for 5 minutes (at most six allies of any relic at once); Dismiss the Moth (use) sends it back. Fearsome Visage (use, twice a day, 1 min): the pattern becomes a terrifying face: every creature within 6 blocks that can see you and fails its save (small creatures nearly always fail, bosses mostly save) is frightened (Tensura Fear), weakened for 8 seconds, slowed for 5 and shoved back. While worn Tensura's Coercion is lent to you, and one hostile monster in five (never a boss, never one you have hurt) will not pick you as its first target.
Became: advantage on Intimidation is Coercion and that one in five; the fear spell (DC 15, a 15-foot reach instead of a cone) is a saving chance read off the creature's size; the moth lasts 5 minutes (not an hour) because that is as long as a summon may stay, and it is an ally, not a mount.
item.nusmp.nightstalkers_mantle.desc: Echolocation (ultrasonic waves) shows hostile creatures through walls, the wings open for sixty seconds of flight with a dashing wing beat, and a thunderous shriek stuns and deafens. It hides you in the dark.
item.nusmp.nightstalkers_mantle.card:
While worn: Echolocation: Tensura's Ultrasonic Waves and Sense Soundwave are lent to you, and every 2 seconds hostile creatures within 20 blocks that you cannot see are outlined for 2.5 seconds (not while Silence deafens you); in the dark (light under 8) Tensura's Presence Concealment hides you. Night Patrol (use, 5 min, costs 1% of your existence points): the wings open and you can fly for 60 seconds (Tensura's Gravity Flight is lent for the same minute), then they fold and you drift down. Wing Dash (use, 6 s): dash forward 9 blocks while the wings are open, 4 otherwise. Shriek (use, 3 min, costs 1.5% of your existence points): a 10-block cone of thunder: 10 damage (6 against a player), half on a successful save; whoever fails is deafened (Silence, 4 seconds) and stunned for 2; invisibility is broken, and they glow for 5 seconds (1 on a save).
Became: blindsight 60 ft is Ultrasonic Waves plus the glow outline; flying 40 ft for an hour is 60 seconds of flight and an existence-point cost; the 6d6 thunder is capped against players; Constitution saves are the size-based saving chance; "until the next dawn" is the 3 minute cooldown; advantage on Stealth is Presence Concealment in the dark.
item.nusmp.cape_of_nine_lives.desc: A cat spirit wards you from death nine times: a lethal blow leaves you on one heart instead, with regeneration to follow. Each rescue makes you more of a cat; the ninth sends the spirit away until a Nether Star calls it back.
item.nusmp.cape_of_nine_lives.card:
Needs attunement. A cat spirit wards you from death nine times: a lethal blow (anything but /kill and the void) leaves you at half a heart instead, with Resistance IV for 5 seconds, absorption hearts, and Self Regeneration and Pain Resistance lent for half a minute; a second lethal blow in the same two seconds is caught for free. Catification Curse: each rescue makes you more of a cat: you see in the dark from the first; each costs half a heart of maximum health (up to four hearts); from the fourth you sometimes knock things over (the nearest dropped item gets a swat). Eating a golden apple (Remove Curse) lifts the cat traits, not the lost lives. Feline Fate: the ninth rescue sends the spirit off, the cape is spent, and you are a cat for 5 minutes (weak, cannot mine, but fast, with Tensura's Beast Transformation lent to you). Make a Wish (use, 30 s): a Nether Star calls the spirit back with all nine lives and no cat traits. Count the Lives (use) tells you where you stand.
Became: the permanent transformation into a cat (only Wish or Divine Intervention) is five minutes and a Nether Star; Greater Restoration is a golden apple; "an effect that kills without damage" is any death that is not /kill or the void.
