djinn_weapon.act.thunder_throw.desc: Hurls a bolt along your gaze that pierces up to five foes, slows them, and jumps on to the nearest others.
djinn_weapon.act.judgement_step.desc: Dashes forward in a trail of lightning, striking and slowing everything you pass.
djinn_weapon.act.sun_cleave.desc: A wide arc of sunfire in front of you: it burns every foe it touches and shoves them back.
djinn_weapon.act.ember_wall.desc: Raises a wall of flame two blocks ahead: foes in it burn and are thrown back; you shrug off fire for five seconds.
djinn_weapon.act.tide_spear.desc: A jet of water along your gaze: it hits everything in its line and pushes it away.
djinn_weapon.act.frost_surge.desc: A cone of freezing water: foes are hurt, frozen and slowed to a crawl.
djinn_weapon.act.cyclone_sweep.desc: Spins a ring of wind round you that throws every foe near you outward and up.
djinn_weapon.act.updraft_leap.desc: Leaps high on a column of wind (and floats down gently), lifting the foes at your feet.
djinn_weapon.act.bloom_heal.desc: A garden opens round you: you and your allies are healed and mended, foes are hurt and rooted by vines.
djinn_weapon.act.thorn_snare.desc: Thorns lash up to three foes in front of you: they are hurt, rooted and poisoned.
djinn_weapon.act.titan_slam.desc: Brings the axe down: a shockwave round you hurts every foe near, harder close in, and throws them into the air.
djinn_weapon.act.rock_breaker.desc: A crushing blow on up to three foes ahead: the more armour they wear the harder it lands, and it leaves them weakened and fragile.
djinn_weapon.act.resonance_wave.desc: A cone of sound: foes are hurt, thrown back and silenced.
djinn_weapon.act.dissonance.desc: A burst of clashing chords round you: foes near you are hurt, dizzied and slowed.
djinn_weapon.act.ember_rush.desc: Pounces forward in a streak of fire, setting alight everything in the path.
djinn_weapon.act.brand.desc: Brands the foe in your sights: it burns, glows, and takes more damage from everyone for eight seconds.
djinn_weapon.act.dawn_arrow.desc: Looses a shaft of dawn light that never drops: it strikes the first two foes in its line, twice as hard against the undead.
djinn_weapon.act.radiant_burst.desc: A flash of first light round you: foes are hurt and blinded, you and your allies are healed.
djinn_weapon.act.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning leaps from foe to foe, a little weaker at each jump.
djinn_weapon.act.storm_pillars.desc: Marks three places (on your foes, else ahead of you): a pillar of storm light falls on each a moment later, stilling what it hits.
djinn_weapon.act.crescent_wind.desc: Two crescents of wind sweep out to either side of your gaze, cutting everything in them and leaving the wounds bleeding.
djinn_weapon.act.heavenly_dash.desc: A dash on the wind, high and long, that cuts every foe on its way.
djinn_weapon.act.abyssal_reap.desc: A wide sweep of the scythe: foes are hurt and filled with dread, and a share of the harm comes back to you as health.
djinn_weapon.act.drowning_pull.desc: Pulls every foe near you in on a black whirlpool: they are hurt, slowed and lose their breath.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.temp: A temporary weapon: %s's Djinn Equip made it. It lasts as long as the Equip; your own item is kept safe and returns when it ends.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.admin: A weapon of %s's Djinn (admin). It does not depend on a Djinn Equip.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.dark: Black rukh: it hits harder and drinks more Magoi.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.act2: Sneak + right-click, Full Equip only: %s (%s%% of your Magoi, %s s)
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_weapon.rules: It cannot be dropped, stored or moved away from its slot; it is always back in your hand.
djinn_weapon.msg.returned: The Djinn weapon fades. Your own items are back.
djinn_weapon.msg.busy: The Djinn is gathering an Extreme Magic: the weapon is still.
djinn_weapon.msg.magoi: Your Magoi is too low for that.
djinn_weapon.msg.nothing: There is nothing in reach to strike.
djinn_weapon.cmd.nodjinn: That player holds no Djinn: name one (weapon give <player> <djinn> [dark]).
djinn_weapon.cmd.cleared: Removed %s Djinn weapon(s) from %s and ended the loan.
